description: Brooks Winterrun Trondheim is Trondheim city centre’s major winter running celebration, taking place on Saturday, 13 February 2027. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as well as volunteers providing extra motivation. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, and everyone receives a medal and a drink at the finish. The event has an inclusive, festive atmosphere, with great prizes drawn after the race.
course_highlights: Run through Trondheim’s streets, with fire baskets and torches
Music along the course creates a great atmosphere
Start waves with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km
additional: Start waves begin approximately 45 seconds apart, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; use your own baggage label. There are no shower or changing facilities at the start or finish area. We recommend arriving ready to run and using baggage transport for extra clothes after the finish. Parking is limited, so we recommend coming without a car. Parking is limited. Baggage is stored outdoors at your own risk, and there are no showers or changing facilities.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 3
description: Nidaros Winter Series is a winter running series organized by Strindheim IL Athletics at Ranheimshallen. The races are held indoors and are suitable for both children and adults, with different distances adapted to all ages. The event has a friendly and inclusive atmosphere, and timing is provided by EQTiming, although times are not eligible for records or annual statistics. The series is part of Strindheim’s long-standing athletics community, which has existed since 1926.
course_highlights: Indoor races at Ranheimshallen
Distances for both children and adults
Timing by EQTiming
additional: Registration is available on race day for a fee. A one-time licence may be charged in addition (20/30 kr). Race 2 is also held at Ranheimshallen, with a 3000 m race for everyone and a 1000 m race for children. Times do not count toward records or annual statistics. Previous information about the series lists EQTiming as the timing system.

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: Vinterkarusellen i Ålesund - 4. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Series is a long-running race series held during the winter months in Ålesund, with five races from November to March. The races take place on certified 5 km and 10 km courses in Brusdalen, starting and finishing at BestDrive in Fremmerholen. The courses are relatively flat and follow Gamle Brusdals veg, which has little car traffic on race days. After the race, juice, cola, coffee and cake are served, and gift prizes are drawn. Participants who complete three or more races receive a series medal at the end of the season.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km and 10 km courses in Brusdalen
Relatively flat courses with little car traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg
Start and finish at BestDrive in Fremmerholen
additional: The 10 km race starts at 13:00 and the 5 km race at 13:05. There is an untimed 5 km recreational class. After the race, juice, cola, coffee and cake are served in the finish area. Gift prizes are drawn after each race. Participants who complete 3 or more races receive a series medal at the final race. Course records for both men and women are listed. The races are held on the second Sunday of each month from November to March. The 5 km is also offered as an untimed recreational class. Registration is via EQ Timing. Participants who complete at least three of the five races are stated to receive a series medal after the final race.

description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is a winter race series in Hamar consisting of six races on a certified 5-kilometer course in the Prestrud area. The course follows lit walking and cycling paths and is suitable for all levels, whether you walk, jog, or run. The event welcomes everyone, from recreational runners to competitive super-runners, and focuses on the joy of running, personal achievement, and socializing throughout the winter. The start and finish are at Prestrudhallen, where light refreshments and facilities are also available. Gun time is used for ranking, while net time is shown in the results list.
course_highlights: Certified 5-kilometer course on lit walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area
The course runs mainly on segregated walking and cycling paths, with some pavement along low-traffic streets
Start and finish at Prestrudhallen, with access to toilets and a shared area for bib pickup and refreshments
additional: A unique mug is awarded to participants who take part in all 6 races. Juice and often cake are served at the finish area. Some changing facilities and indoor toilets are available at Prestrudhallen, but runners are advised to shower at home. Results service with live split times via EQ Timing. Gun time is used for ranking; net time is shown in the results list. Registration via EQ Timing is open until the start. The course is cleared of snow and gritted as needed; a reflective vest is recommended, but a headlamp is not necessary.

The series consists of several races throughout the winter and early spring, and is suitable for both young people and adults. It is a long-standing event with good opportunities to compare your time with previous records.

The course passes Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route
The race takes place in Arna, Bergen, with several dates in winter/spring

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r2 - 5000m/10000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series s3r2 is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo, with distances of 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters. It is part of a popular distance series that attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The race takes place on a classic athletics track and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year in a welcoming environment. The event is well organized and suited to anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, an iconic athletics track in Oslo
The distances are 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters on the track
Well suited to both recreational and competitive runners

The start and finish are at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The races take place on Mondays from October to April, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-Timing, and discount codes are available for different membership groups.

Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Races take place on winter evenings, starting at 18:45

An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration responsibility and payment are handled via EQ-Timing. The races are held as a series, with the option to register for the entire series or individual races. Registration is individual via EQ-Timing. IL Gneist members are eligible for discounts. Participants over 13 may need an annual licence; a surcharge of NOK 50 is listed for those without an annual licence.

description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups can participate for free with a valid licence.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races start at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for members of IL Gneist athletics (free with a valid licence), Gneist trim (50% discount), and other Gneist groups (25% discount). name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 8. løp Lillestrøm
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place in Lillestrøm and the surrounding area and are part of a traditional winter series that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, ensuring insurance coverage and medical assistance if needed. The event promotes versatility and combines training and competition in a social setting.
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must purchase an athletics license individually. Children under 13 are covered by the child sports insurance and do not need their own license. Lørenskog Friidrettslag has training groups for different age groups and ability levels, and organizes several running and athletics events in the area. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the Child Sports Insurance.

description: The Bergen Marathon Series is a series of six races throughout the year, where participants can run both the half marathon and the full marathon. Bergen is regarded as Norway’s number one marathon city, and the series places great emphasis on quality and runners’ enjoyment, even though the races offer tough challenges. By completing five of the six races in the series, you receive a commemorative plaque. The February Marathon is the second race in the series and is held during the winter months, offering a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year.
course_highlights: The races are held in Bergen, known as Norway’s number one marathon city
The series consists of six races, with both half-marathon and full-marathon options
The courses are quality-assured with a national course certificate and an IAU label
additional: Kondis membership gives a NOK 50 discount. You can provide an annual licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation to avoid paying for a one-time licence. The minimum age for the marathon is 18. The Bergen Marathon Series is held in collaboration with BFG Bergen Running Club. It is possible to rent a function room at Fana Stadium. Complete five of the Bergen Marathon Series races to receive a plaque. Details about registration and the 2027 edition are not provided in the sources.

name: Maratonkarusellen 2027 Løp 2 Februar Maraton
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
description: Maratonkarusellen organizes several races in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, focusing on quality and a great experience for participants. The races include both half and full marathons, as well as other distances such as 10 km and ultramarathons. The February Marathon, held in Bergen, offers a challenging and beautiful course, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium. This race is part of a series of six races held throughout the year and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Course starts and finishes at Fana Stadium in Bergen
Includes both half-marathon and marathon distances
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, with a focus on quality
additional: Maratonkarusellen organizes three races in the spring and three in the fall each year. The races also include Bergen Skogsmaraton, with a 10 km distance, and Bergen Ultra, with 63.3 km and 100 km distances. Maratonkarusellen has hosted the Norwegian 100 km Championships six times. The focus is on making sure all participants enjoy themselves despite the tough challenges. Available distances are half marathon (21,097 meters) and marathon (42,195 meters).

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail is a unique winter adventure in Inari, offering participants the chance to experience Arctic nature and the Northern Lights. This winter trail-running event takes runners through stunning scenery in the Lapland wilderness, offering unforgettable experiences immersed in nature. The event is part of the Trail to Be Alive series, known for its high-quality and memorable trail races around the world. Runners can expect a challenging but rewarding course that combines the tranquillity of nature with the beauty of winter.
course_highlights: Arctic winter wilderness in Inari
A chance to see the Northern Lights
A challenging trail-running course immersed in nature
additional: The event is part of an international trail tour, but further details about the course or registration are not available.

name: Sydvest Crossløb 2026/27 - Cup tilmelding alle løb
SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on the Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km route on the Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km laps
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Manned aid stations at km 15/45 and an additional one near the finish area for the 50 km. Heated cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish through Des ti nation Snogeholm. Start and finish at Gydarps gård in Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km. Emergency blanket and mobile phone are mandatory equipment. Limited number of places.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 6. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing race series organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many runners of all ages. The event offers a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with light refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Run through scenic surroundings in Bjørgene, Karmøy
Races are held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Start at 19:00; race bibs can be collected from 18:00
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 18:00. Juice, biscuits and fruit are served after the finish. The running series is organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club and relies on volunteer efforts.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 5. løp
description: Samnanger IL Running Group invites you to Vinterkarusellen, a friendly and sociable race starting and finishing at Nesodden. You can choose between 2 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The race is suitable for all levels and paces, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, maintain your fitness or simply enjoy a sociable run. Remember to wear reflective gear, as it is dark at this time of year.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km or 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: The race is held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter. It is a free, accessible event suitable for everyone. The running group focuses on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the dark winter season. Start at 18:30. The organizer reminds participants to wear reflective gear in the dark.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Rebild Bakker Trail
Lapland Arctic Ultra
description: Lapland Arctic Ultra is an extreme winter race held in Överkalix, Swedish Lapland. The race offers several distances from 20 km to 500 km, and participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. The courses follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests, with spectacular views and challenging Arctic conditions. The start and finish are at Grand Arctic Resort, and the race crosses the Arctic Circle twice on the 185 km distance. This is a unique challenge for endurance athletes who want to test their limits in Europe’s last wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses on snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests
The 185 km distance crosses the Arctic Circle twice
Start and finish at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix
additional: Participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. A mandatory training camp is required for participants with no experience in extreme cold. Transfers are available from Jockfall to the start area, including transport of pulks. There is no prize purse. Drop bags are not allowed under the rules. The start is at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix, beside the Kalix River. A training course is planned for 2–5 March 2027 and is mandatory for participants with no experience in extreme cold.

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett, marking the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. The race takes place in Ringsaker, Hedmark, and attracts around 100 participants despite varying weather conditions. Participants must wear a reflective vest and take care in traffic. Both timed and fitness classes are offered. The event is especially important this year, with many opportunities for exercise and competition having been cancelled.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
Distance of 6.9 kilometers
Reflective vest required; participants must take care in traffic
additional: Both timed and untimed fitness classes are available. The event attracts around 100 participants each time. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. A reflective vest is required; a headlamp and good winter footwear may be useful.

The races take place on a certified 5 km course that starts at Espeland sports ground and runs via Gamle Haukeland station, mainly on walking and cycling paths with little traffic. The series consists of six races throughout the winter and is suitable for both young people and adults, with a friendly atmosphere and a shared love of running. IL Fri has a long tradition as an organizer and also offers discounts for club members.

The course runs mostly on walking and cycling paths or roads with little traffic
Start and finish at Espeland sports ground

name: Landeveisløp 8km
location: IL Skade Clubhouse, Kåsa, Nome, Telemark, Norway
description: The Lunde Road Race is a traditional 8 km road race organised by IL Skade’s athletics group. It follows the beautiful, flat route alongside the Telemark Canal, starting and finishing at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa. The race has a long history and has been held more than 50 times, previously as part of the Vinterkarusellen in Telemark. After the race, participants are invited to socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving at the clubhouse, where changing rooms and showers are also available.
course_highlights: Flat route of approximately 7.8 km alongside the Telemark Canal
Start and finish at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa
More than 50 years of tradition; one of the oldest races in the area

Changing rooms and showers are available at the clubhouse. After the race, participants can socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving. Registration on race day is at the clubhouse from approximately 11:00 to 12:30, or by SMS.

name: Vinterkarusellen i Ålesund - 5. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Series is a long-standing race series held over five races during the winter months in Ålesund. The races take place on officially measured courses in Brusdalen, over distances of 5 and 10 km, and start at BestDrive in Fremmerholen. The courses are relatively flat and follow Gamle Brusdals veg, with little traffic on race days. After the race, juice, cola, cake and coffee are served, and medals are awarded to those who take part in three or more races in the series.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 and 10 km courses in Brusdalen
Relatively flat courses with little traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg
Start and finish at BestDrive in Fremmerholen
additional: The races start at 13:00 for the 10 km and 13:05 for the 5 km. There is a non-timed recreational category over 5 km. Gift prizes are drawn after each race. Medals are awarded to participants who complete three or more races in the series. Juice, cola, cake and coffee are served in the finish area after the race. Registration is through EQ Timing. The 5 km is also available as a non-timed recreational category. Juice, cola, cake and coffee are served in the finish area.

name: Edsvidsleden Trailrun
price_range: 50 kr för T-shirt från tidigare år
description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 14 km course on the classic Edsvidsleden trail in Trollhättan
The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged
Water is available at approximately 9 km and in the start and finish area
additional: The start and finish have been moved to Forngården in Trollhättan. There is no parking at the start; park on the streets in Strömslund or at Torsbovallen. Bring your own water and cup. T-shirts from previous years will be sold on race day for 50 kr each. Course records for men and women are listed for the 14 km, 28 km and 56 km distances from previous years. All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Hamarkarusellen vinter Løp 6
description: The Hamarkarusellen Winter Series is a running series for everyone, whether you are an experienced runner, a recreational runner, or simply looking to get outside for some fresh air. The series consists of six races over the winter months, all on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar. The races focus on activity, achievement, and socializing, and everyone is welcome regardless of pace—you can run, jog, walk, or combine them. Participants who take part in at least four of the six races receive a finisher’s prize. The event offers a friendly atmosphere, with gingerbread and cordial at the finish.
course_highlights: Six races on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar
The course is suitable for running, jogging, and walking
A social and motivating winter series focused on achievement and activity
additional: A finisher’s prize is awarded to everyone who takes part in at least four of the six races. Participants are encouraged to wear a Santa hat, and gingerbread and cordial are served at the finish. The member price applies to members of corporate sports clubs and individual members of the Innlandet Regional Corporate Sports Association. Everyone is welcome, with an accessible format and room for all levels. Registration is available for individual races or the entire series.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 4
description: Åsane running series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, Bergen, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified, suits all levels, and is led by experienced coaches. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected on site before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course, measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured and certified by Ivar Andreas Sandø
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The races take place on Thursdays. Start time: 19:00. Race numbers can be collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. The start and finish are at the rear of the IKEA building, facing south.

Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear on the south side

The prices listed on the information page apply to 2026 and are therefore not included as prices for 2027.

name: Frozen Lake Marathon
description: Frozen Lake Marathon is a unique running event held on the frozen surface of Lake Tisleifjorden in Norway, 819 meters above sea level. Participants run entirely on ice, on a course with the flattest elevation profile in the world, making it an unforgettable experience. The race is limited to 500 participants and offers both a half marathon and a full marathon. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal for all finishers, with warm soup and bread served after the race. The course is carefully monitored and laid out just days before the race to ensure safety on the ice.
course_highlights: 100% ice surface on Lake Tisleifjorden, with ice about 80 cm thick
The flattest elevation profile in the world
Energy stations at several points, offering sports drinks, water, energy bars, dried fruit, and chocolate
additional: Limited to 500 participants. Transfer is included only for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; shuttle service is available at a cost from Storefjell Resort. Parking near the race area is very limited; studded tires are recommended for driving. Bag-drop service is available with a bib tag. Basic changing tents and portaloo toilets are provided. Warm soup with bread is served after the race. Arrival by train to Gol is recommended; the official race hotel is Oset Fjellhotell. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal, and warm soup with bread is served after the race. Transport is included for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; parking near the race area is very limited.

name: 6. Ekeberg Backyard Ultra
description: Ekeberg Backyard Ultra is a classic backyard ultra race held in Oslo’s “central park” at Ekeberg. The race takes place during the dark and cold time of year, giving participants the opportunity to run together with the ultra-running family in beautiful surroundings, with views of Oslo’s skyline and the Oslofjord. The event offers a unique atmosphere with live music, good vibes and facilities such as changing rooms and tents. A maximum of 110 participants can take part, and everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful scenery with views of the Oslofjord and Oslo’s skyline
The event takes place at Bekkelagshøgda Tennis Club, with access to changing rooms and tents
Live music and good vibes with the ultra-running family
additional: Participants receive a race bib and tracker for automatic live recording of lap times. Drinks, snacks and some hot food are provided. Maximum 110 participants. Everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal. The race starts at 09:00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026 at 00:01. Participants receive a tracker for lap times, access to the venue and changing rooms, drinks, snacks and hot food. Medals are awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is an annual running event held on the second Saturday in March in Skatås, Gothenburg. The classic race course is the “gravel eight,” a course just under 8 km long where participants can choose to run one, two or four laps. Since 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail has also been held, a new trail race of approximately 16 km in the Skatås and Delsjö area. The event offers a well-organized and varied running experience, with water stations and prize ceremonies for the fastest runners in each category.
course_highlights: The “gravel eight” race course in Skatås, approximately 7.8 km per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running in the Skatås and Delsjö area
Water stations with water and sports drink on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse. Timing is recorded using a disposable chip on the back of the race bib. Changing and shower facilities are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. Prize ceremonies take place in the finish area shortly after each category finishes. Live results are available during race day. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Vårtävlingarna arrangeras andra lördagen i mars varje år.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Forest To The Bay Blokhus
Lillestrøms Høyeste Trappeløp
description: Lillestrøm’s Highest Stair Race takes place at Scandic Lillestrøm, with its 12 floors, and offers a real challenge for anyone who wants to test themselves, their friends, family, or colleagues. The race is suitable for all levels and is open to participants aged 13 and over. The event starts at 18:00, with race bibs and timing chips available for collection from 17:00. EMIT timing chips record start time, split time, and finish time, and results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor.
course_highlights: The race goes up 12 floors at Scandic Lillestrøm
EMIT timing chips record start, split, and finish times
Results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from 17:00. Warm-up is self-directed, outdoors or indoors where space is available. Luggage can be left in a hotel meeting room at your own risk. Toilets are on the 1st and 2nd floors. Using public transport is recommended, as Scandic Lillestrøm is 50 metres from the train station and 150 metres from the bus station. Parking is limited, but commuter parking in the parking garage or at Varemessen (approx. 200 m away) is recommended if arriving by car. Group registration and a single invoice are available for corporate sports clubs and businesses. Timing is done using EMIT chips.

name: Påskekonrad
description: PåskeKonrad is a short race with a mass start from Brunstad, formerly Nærbutikken, in Velledalen. The race is held annually and attracts both locals and experienced veteran runners. Participants can register on race day or in advance via EQ-timing, which helps the organizer with planning. After the race, participants can shower and change at Tandstad School, where an informal gathering is also held. Everyone is warmly welcome to take part in this enjoyable event, whatever their pace.
course_highlights: Mass start from Brunstad, by the former Nærbutikken
A short race with variable weather conditions, often rain and wind
Showers and an after-race gathering at Tandstad School
additional: Registration is available on race day from 09:00 and in advance via EQ-timing. After the race, showers and dry clothes are available at Tandstad School, where a small gathering is also held. Weather conditions can vary, with rain, wind, and snow later in the day. Registration can be done on race day or in advance via EQ-timing. There is a simple after-race get-together at Tandstad School.

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://forslovtrail.se/): 2027-03-26 — "Vi ses 26 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-02)

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://eiflopning.se/arrangemang/pasksmallen/): 2027-03-29 — "Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen." (was estimated 2026-10-18)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Sandtangstafetten
description: Sandtangstafetten is a traditional relay held at Sandtangen in Bryne. The race has four legs on varied surfaces, including forest floor, gravel and grass, and offers both a short and a long course for different age groups, from age 7 to seniors. The event starts in the evening and lasts approximately one hour and fifteen minutes, with a focus on team spirit and a great atmosphere. It is a family-friendly race, with many mixed teams as well as all-girls and all-boys teams competing in different categories.
course_highlights: Short course for ages 7–10, with 110 m legs on forest floor, gravel and grass
Long course for ages 11 and older, with 370 m and 420 m legs on varied surfaces
Four legs per relay team, with changeovers at Sandtangen
additional: Start times for the different categories are from 18:00 to 18:36. Participants are advised to arrive 45 minutes before the start for a course and changeover briefing. Parking is available at Vianor Bryne (north) and Storstova (south). Registration is available via a link or by emailing pamelding@brynefriidrett.no. Parking at Vianor Bryne or Storstova.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular trail race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a lovely Easter tradition, attracting participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a celebration of running with a focus on community, and children’s and youth races make it a day for the whole family. Alongside the race, there’s a wonderful atmosphere, prizes for the top finishers in each category, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of trail running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy and fast to run
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and all participants are entered in prize draws. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Vänersborg. The race is a celebration of running focused on community, attracting both elite and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding skjer ved at du Vippser kr 150 til #609846 med info om navn, klubb/lag.

description: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra takes place in Gressvikmarka, starting Saturday, April 3 at 08:00. The race consists of up to 12 laps on a 6.7 km course through varied and challenging terrain. Participants run one lap every hour and continue for as long as they can, aiming to complete as many laps as possible or all 12. All participants receive a medal, and those who complete every lap can log over 80 km in their training diary. Facilities include a heated shelter, toilets, changing rooms, and some fruit and baked goods.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course through varied terrain
Up to 12 laps, with over 80 km for those who complete them all
The course is marked with red and white ribbons
additional: Check-in and registration from 07:00 on race day. To continue, participants must be ready for the next lap at the top of each hour. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms are available. Bring a change of clothes, drinks, food, and possibly a headlamp. The course may be wet and muddy; a camping chair is recommended for the break area. The previous edition had a maximum of 77 participants. The race started at 08:00, and runners had to be ready at the start at the top of each hour to continue. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms were available. Sources give conflicting information about the date in 2027.

name: Holmestrand maraton
description: Holmestrand Marathon is a friendly running event that has been a regular fixture on the race calendar since 2013. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter and offers beautiful, easy-to-run courses along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city’s charming streets. Distances are available for all levels, from 5 km to the marathon, and the course has been officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and also includes a free children’s race called Miniton.
course_highlights: Easy-to-run, personal-best-friendly 5 km loop course
Course along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city streets
Officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics
additional: All children can take part in the free Miniton children’s race. The race offers the option to run with or without a time. There are food and drink stations, prizes, and opportunities to follow the race along the course. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and the free Miniton for children. For the 5 km, you can choose to run with or without a time. The event also offers the combinations marathon + 10 km and half marathon + 5 km.

name: Drammen 10K
description: Drammen10K is Norway’s fastest 10-kilometer race, taking runners through downtown Drammen on a fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain. The race is for everyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience in an urban setting. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and also offers fun digital competitions beforehand. Welcome to a great race weekend in Drammen!
course_highlights: Norway’s fastest 10K race
Fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain
The race takes place in downtown Drammen
additional: Green race bibs indicate that a medal was purchased in advance. Children’s races are also held on the same day, including Minimila. There is no telephone contact; all communication takes place via email and the contact form. A digital triathlon with prizes and a live announcement on social media is held beforehand. Transferring a race bib or changing the participant costs 100 NOK.

name: Bergen Ultra - Maratonkarusellen
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

description: Bergen Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon organized by Maratonkarusellen in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb. The event offers distances of 63.3 km and 100 km, as well as a half marathon and marathon, and takes place at Fana Stadium in Bergen. Maratonkarusellen places great emphasis on quality and participant enjoyment, despite the event’s tough challenges. The minimum age is 18, and the race is part of a series of long-distance events held in both spring and autumn.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances of 63.3 km and 100 km
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
The races start and take place at Fana Stadium in Bergen
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. A year-round license from the Norwegian Athletics Federation can be provided by giving the license number, and a one-time license does not need to be paid for. Prices increase by NOK 50 two weeks before race day, by a further NOK 50 four days before, and the price on race day is NOK 650. The minimum age for the marathon is 18. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium. The half marathon is one lap, the marathon two laps, and the 63 km race three laps. The listed start times are 09:00 for 63 km, 10:00 for the marathon, and 11:00 for the half marathon. The prices and race details apply to the published 2026 edition; information for 3 April 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Solsiå sentrumsløp
description: Solsiå Sentrumsløp 2027 takes place in Sandnes city centre and features a circuit where participants choose how many laps to complete within six hours. There is also a separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata. The race has an informal, inclusive character, focusing on local runners and safe preparation. Registration and payment are handled directly by the organiser, not through Førstart.
course_highlights: A 3 km circuit in Sandnes city centre
Choose how many laps to complete within six hours
A separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, and the circuit race starts at 12:00. Registration and payment are handled by the organiser, not through Førstart. Limited practical information about the race is available on Førstart. Feel free to invite others to the starting line. The circuit race starts at 12:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:30. Registration and payment are handled by the organiser.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.
