description: Our 5K! is the first race in Oslo Running Festival and offers a fast, flat 5-kilometer course along the beautiful Oslofjord, from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket. You can complete the race at any time between April 9 and 18, or join the group start on Sunday, April 18 at 11:00, with pacers, music, and a great atmosphere. This race is a great way to kick off the running season in Oslo and is suitable for anyone looking to test their fitness on a fast, enjoyable course.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 5 km course along the Oslofjord
The course runs from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket
Option to join the group start with pacers and music
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same bib is used throughout the series. A new bib can be purchased for 75 kr. The courses are marked only for the group start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. The race can be completed at any time between April 9 and 18, 2027. Registration is offered as SOLO, DUO, and TRIO tickets; listed prices vary by ticket type and purchase date.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, Hammerås, offering a simple and efficient race format for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, where runners can leave their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The race is known for producing many personal records and has a friendly atmosphere, with the option to ring the bell when setting a personal record.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available inside the school. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs can be collected via self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: Baroniløpet
description: Baroniløpet is organized annually by Rosendal Turnlag and takes place in beautiful surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal in Kvinnherad. The race is part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series and attracts both local and visiting runners looking for a challenging race in scenic surroundings. The terrain offers varied surfaces and beautiful nature, making the race a popular event for both recreational and competitive runners. The event has a long tradition and is well integrated into the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal
Varied surfaces, including trails and wooded sections
Part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series

name: Neskollen Backyard Ultra
description: Neskollen Backyard is a unique ultramarathon held at Nes Arena in Neskollen. The race follows the classic backyard format, with a new start every hour on the hour. Participants must complete a 6.706 km loop within 60 minutes to continue. They can run up to 12 loops in total, equivalent to approximately 80.5 km. The race is a demanding test of both mental and physical strength, and is suitable for experienced ultrarunners as well as those who want to challenge their limits. Food and drinks are available during the race, and prizes are awarded to participants.
course_highlights: Relatively flat course around Nes Arena
Start and finish inside Nes Arena, with a short break between loops
Up to 12 loops of 6.706 km each, approximately 80.5 km for those who complete them
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 loops. Participants can take a break inside Nes Arena between loops to eat, rest and prepare. Pizza, cakes, drinks and potato chips are served during the race. Prizes are awarded. The maximum is 12 loops, equivalent to approximately 80.5 kilometres. The available information applies to the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Skjold på tvers
description: Skjold på Tvers is a mountain marathon and the most beautiful spring adventure in Vindafjord, Rogaland. The race offers several route options, including the full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks over approximately 21.2 km, as well as shorter options such as HalvTversen and a family route. Participants are transported from Skjold Arena to the start, and chip timing and prize money are offered in the elite class. The event combines challenging terrain with beautiful scenery and is suitable for both fit runners and families.
course_highlights: The full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks, approximately 21.2 km
HalvTversen, with 4 peaks (11.4 km) or 3 peaks (9.6 km)
Family route at Vikaneset, with a trail and an alternative for strollers/wheelchairs
additional: You can also register on the day via EQ Timing at Skjold Arena, but advance registration is recommended. Bus transport from Skjold Arena to the start at Hodnafjellet is included in the price. It is possible to walk half the route, with a bus to or from Dalavik. Participants receive a T-shirt, fruit and drinks at designated stations. The elite class has a mass start at 13:00, with timing and prize money. The route page has a UT.no map and GPX file. The main route runs from Hodnafjellet to Skjold Arena.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a simple and effective running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table, passed on every lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, and the event has a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate personal records by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Option to set up your own nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected self-service at Ås school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can set out their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. An official aid station staffed by 9th grade students from Feiring school is available at selected races. Timing and a lap-time calculator are available for planning. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Race bibs are collected self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available via RaceDays.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a trail-running adventure that takes you out into exciting natural surroundings and new experiences. The race offers a fairytale-like run through beech forests, past small lakes and historical sites such as Bexell’s Talking Stones. After the run, a locally produced picnic awaits to round things off. The event is open to runners of different paces and recommends carpooling for participants.
course_highlights: Run through the beech forests of Kinnekulle
Pass small, charming lakes and Bexell’s Talking Stones
Finish with a picnic at a locally producing farm
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. The distance is approximately 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating rides is offered. The event is designed to provide a welcoming, nature-focused running experience centred on nature, views and local food.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Stomperudkarusellen - løp nr 1
price_range: Enkeltløp i 2026: 110–220 kr, med lisens på 20–30 kr i tillegg
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, including shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum school and Stomperud Stadium, and the same race number is used throughout the series. This makes it easy and enjoyable for children, young people, and adults to take part in several races during the season.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register at least one week before race day. The races are held in the evening and start at 19:00. Shorter options are available for the youngest participants at every race. The prices are listed for 2026 and may change before the 2027 edition. The same race number is used in all races in the series.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Vänersborgs AIK
description: Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan is a fast 10 km race that debuted on 21 April 2026. The course is officially measured and runs along fast cycle paths around Stallbacka, on a 3.3 km loop completed three times. The start and finish are next to the tennis hall. The race is organised by Vänersborgs AIK and Trollhättans IF Friidrott, and pacers are available from 35 to 60 minutes to help runners at different paces.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course on fast cycle paths
3.3 km loop completed three times
Start and finish next to the tennis hall in Trollhättan
additional: Pacers are available for finish times from 35 to 60 minutes. You can also register for Digitala Varvetmilen to get a seeding time for Göteborgsvarvet. The start and finish are next to the tennis hall in Trollhättan. Pacers are available for finish times from 35 to 60 minutes.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: Terrengløp i Smidalen
organizer: Nidelv IL Friidrett og Nidelv IL Ski
description: The Smidalen cross-country run is an accessible event for children and young people in grades 1 to 7, organized by Nidelv IL Athletics and Ski in cooperation with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. The races take place on a circuit of approximately 1,000 metres in the scenic surroundings of Smidalen, Trondheim. Participants run 1 to 3 laps depending on their grade, with a mass start for everyone. The event promotes well-rounded exercise and the joy of competition among children in the local community.
course_highlights: Approximately 1,000-metre cross-country circuit
Race distance adapted to age: 1–3 laps
Mass start for all participants
additional: The races are held several times a year, with a focus on children and young people. Coaches and team leaders are encouraged to prioritize participation over their own training. The event is part of a sponsorship agreement with Kjeldsberg Eiendom. Previous race formats have been 1 lap for grades 1–3, 2 laps for grades 4–5, and 3 laps for grades 6–7. The information applies to previous editions; no information about 2027 has been provided.

name: Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon
description: Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon is organized by Turn og Idrettsforeningen Viking and is one of Scandinavia’s largest road races. The race brings together both Bergen residents and visitors for a festival in the heart of Bergen, with five different distances suitable for all ages and levels. The main distance is a challenging marathon consisting of two 21 km laps. The event offers an inclusive and inspiring running experience focused on activity, achievement, and community.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Bergen’s streets, with beautiful views and technical sections
The main distance consists of two 21 km laps
Five different distances for all levels and ages
additional: Registration is binding and includes an administration fee of 25 kr as well as a license to the athletics federation. It is possible to resell your race bib until 17 April 2027 via a voucher code. Official participant information will be sent out on 14 April 2027. Relay teams are also available, with separate team leader administration and a joint invoice for companies. Registration is available both individually and for companies and organizations. Company teams can be managed by a team leader and receive a joint invoice.

name: Fevik halvmaraton og 5 km
description: Fevik Half Marathon and 5 km are organized by IL Express Friidrett at Fevik Stadium in Grimstad. The race is part of the club’s annual events and offers both recreational and experienced runners a great opportunity to take part in a well-organized race in scenic surroundings. IL Express Friidrett has an active community, with weekly group runs and several races throughout the year, making this a popular event in the local area.
course_highlights: The races start and finish at Fevik Stadium
Scenic surroundings in the Grimstad area
Both half marathon and 5 km distances are offered
additional: IL Express Friidrett also organizes three annual track meets in May, August, and October. Weekly group runs take place on Thursdays at 19:00 from Fevik Stadium.

name: Vinstra Byløp
price_range: 200 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for barneløp og bamseløp (2026-utgaven)
description: Vinstra City Run is an inclusive running event in Vinstra Park, welcoming participants of all ages, from 2 years and up. The event focuses on public health, diversity and the joy of running, with options including a children’s park run, an untimed fun run, and timed 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are in Vinstra Park, and participants are encouraged to take part in teams such as family, friends or colleagues. There are prizes and start-number prize draws, and the aim is to establish an annual running event for all levels.
course_highlights: Children’s park run and teddy bear run in the park for the youngest participants
5 km and 10 km races with electronic timing
Untimed fun-run category where participants can walk or run
additional: Participants are advised to arrive 1 hour before the start. Prize ceremony at approximately 13:00. Joint warm-up for the 5 km and 10 km at 11:30. Start of the timed 5 km and 10 km races and the fun-run category at 12:00. Previous editions have offered an untimed 5 km fun-run category and timed 5 km and 10 km races. The listed distances and prices apply to previous editions and have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Glommaløpet
description: Glommaløpet is an annual race on a gravel path along the final kilometres of the Glomma, from Sarpefossen to Gamlebyen in Fredrikstad. The course starts in the square in Sarpsborg and passes through Kulåsparken, over Sannesund Bridge, along the eastern bank of the Glomma and under Fredrikstad Bridge, finishing in the historic fortress town of Gamlebyen. The event offers several distances and categories, including 10 miles, a relay, a recreational run and a children's race, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The course is flat and easy to run, with scenic surroundings and water stations along the way.
course_highlights: Run on a gravel path along the Glomma's final kilometres, from Sarpefossen to the sea at Gamlebyen
Start in the square in Sarpsborg and finish in Gamlebyen, the best-preserved fortress town in the Nordic countries
Flat course profile with water stations at 4.5, 5, 9.5 and 14.5 km
additional: Glommaløpet has one start group per event, with no wave starts. The maximum number of participants is limited to ensure smooth flow and sufficient capacity at the water stations. Race numbers can be collected in the square in Sarpsborg on race day from 11:00 to 13:30, or earlier at selected locations in Fredrikstad and Sarpsborg. Bus transport is available for participants and must be booked by 18 April at the latest. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to category winners and relay teams. A technical running shirt with the Glommaløpet print can be purchased when registering by 24 March. The 10-mile distance is 16 km. The relay consists of ten legs ranging from 800 metres to 3 kilometres. There are three water stations, and bus transport must be booked in advance. Changing rooms and showers are available at Kongstenhallen and Sarpsborghallen.

name: Hell Backyard Ultra
description: Hell Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-meter lap in under an hour. The race continues hour by hour until only one runner remains and completes a full lap alone, known as Last Man Standing. The race takes place at Trudvang community hall in Lånke and offers a challenging but social ultrarunning experience, with the option of personal support within the start and finish area. The race record is 42 laps, set in 2026.
course_highlights: The lap is 6,706 meters long and must be completed in under an hour
The course runs from Trudvang toward Hell and Hell station, along the shore and the Stjørdal River, then back to Lånke athletics track
Start and finish at Trudvang community hall, with the option to use a tent or indoor space
additional: The race starts at 09:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. Personal support is permitted within the start and finish area, but not out on the course. Basic refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are provided, and it is possible to set up a tent near the start area. Participants must remain within the course area during the race. Start at 09:00 at Trudvang community hall in Lånke. Race director: Lars Erik Gylland.

name: Sparebank1 Østlandet-mila Moelv 2027 - 10000 meter/3000 meter på bane
Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet is a trail race organized by Björnstorps IF at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. Races are offered over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, with the 3 km race also having recreational categories for men and women. The courses follow Skryllegården’s fitness trails through varied woodland terrain on gravel surfaces. Skrylleloppet is a welcoming race with professional timing and results reporting, and also serves as a qualifying race for the TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Trail race on varied woodland trails
Gravel surfaces on fitness trails
The 10 km race offers the opportunity to qualify for the TCS Lidingöloppet
additional: Registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants can also register on site and make a name or category change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; payment is by Swish only. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be collected from Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race. Participants who cycle to the race can enter a prize draw at the awards ceremony at 11:30. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly race through the scenic surroundings of Skälby Gård in Kalmar. The event offers several distances, from short 600-metre youth races to 8 km for adults, on routes featuring lovely park paths, gravel, asphalt and trail. It’s a perfect race to kick off the running season, with water available on the lap and at the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and park paths, with a short section on asphalt and some trail.
Water is available on the lap of the long course and at the finish.
The 4 km and 8 km courses are one and two laps respectively, crossing the bridge.
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Skälby loge on race day from 8:30 a.m. Youth races start from 10:00 a.m.; adult men’s and women’s races start at 11:00 a.m. New: a 4 km untimed walking category. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Information about previous editions also lists a 4 km untimed walking category. All finishers receive a medal. The published information applies to the 2026 race and does not confirm the date of 24 April 2027.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon that runs through scenic parts of Gärdet and Södra Djurgården in Stockholm. The start and finish are at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen. The race is perfect preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, but also suits anyone who wants to welcome spring with a great half marathon in an urban setting. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of asphalt, gravel and paving stones, with a total elevation gain of 183 metres.
course_highlights: The course runs through Gärdet and Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel and paving stones
Total elevation gain of 183 metres, with kilometre markers at every kilometre
additional: The race has a time limit of 3 hours. Enervit sports drink will be available during the race. Bib collection takes place at Gärdet sports field on Friday 24 April from 10:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 25 April from 08:00 to 11:00. Participants who collect their bib on Friday receive IcePower Cold Gel and a Scholl foot mask. Registered participants receive 25% off adidas shoes and clothing at the adidas pop-up store at Löplabbet from 20–26 April. Race rules prohibit, among other things, strollers, inline skates, roller skis and competition wheelchairs. Wheelchair participants start in the final starting group, and guides are free of charge. The provisional start time is 11:00 and the time limit is three hours. Minimum age: 17. Race-day registration is available until 09:00, subject to availability.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarhalvan/): 2027-04-24 — "Spring adidas Premiärhalvan den 24 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-24)

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 550:-  för individuell start inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900:- för ett lag inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly trails through forests and meadows and along the archipelago coast, with a soft, gentle surface suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race qualifies runners for seeding at TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to get a better start group in the classic autumn trail race. Water and sports drinks are available at aid stations, and there is entertainment along the course. After the race, refreshments and light food are available to buy at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails and hilly terrain
The course is mostly on soft trails and gravel
Beautiful scenery featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Aid stations with water and sports drinks at 5 km and at the finish. The course is marked with white flagging tape and spray-painted arrows, with course marshals at difficult points. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available at Lidingövallen. Free bag storage is available, but not for electronic items. Valuables storage costs 20 kr. Group warm-up before the start. Public transport or cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Category changes and name changes are possible for a fee. A children’s race (Knattarnas Vårmil) takes place before the main races. The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the 5 km at 11:10 on 24 April 2027. The 10 km course has an aid station at 5 km and drinks at the finish. Parking is limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-varmilen/startinformation): 2027-04-24 — "Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen" (was estimated 2027-04-24)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen

name: Retrovarvet 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: När du fått en plats bekräftar önskvärt din anmälan, senast under löpdagen, med 100 kr som du donerar till årets utvalda välgörenhet

description: Retrovarvet is an annual run that follows the Göteborgsvarvet’s inaugural 1980 course. It is a 21.1 km training run that has been held since 2008. It is not a race, but a social group training session focused on enjoyment, experience and charity. The event is volunteer-run and aims to support children in need. This year’s fundraiser is for Ågrenska and its work with families and children with rare diagnoses. The start and finish are at Heden in Göteborg, and the run takes approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes at a pace of around 6:30 min/km.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km course following the Göteborgsvarvet’s inaugural 1980 course
Start and finish at Heden, Göteborg
A group training session focused on social connection and experience
additional: Maximum 750 participants. The event is a training session, not a race, and participation is at your own risk. Runners are asked to follow laws and regulations, never run ahead of the pacer, and stay on sidewalks. Pace: approximately 6:30 min/km; the run takes approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes. Register by emailing premiarbanan1980@gmail.com with your name and email address. For 2026, participants are asked to gather at Heden at 07:45 and register via premiarbanan1980@gmail.com. The website states that participation is limited to 750; the registration details apply to the 2026 event.

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning festival and Swedish Championships organized by Växjö Löparklubb in collaboration with the Swedish Athletics Association. The event takes place on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö and offers several championship distances, including 24-hour running and 100 km. The course is flat and consists mainly of asphalt with some gravel sections, making it fast and spectator-friendly. Both runners and walkers are welcome for a weekend of challenge and community.
course_highlights: Flat loop course of approximately 820 meters on asphalt and gravel
Approximately 3.2 km loop around Lake Trummen on asphalt and gravel
Event area on open grassy spaces on the southern shore of Lake Trummen
additional: The pre-race dinner is held on Friday, April 24. Lap counting takes place at the arena, where there is room for the organizer's tents and participants' own tents. The women's SM half-marathon walk starts at 10:00. The VXO24h course is approximately 820 m, while the courses for VXO100k and the SM 42 km and 21 km walking events are approximately 3.2 km around Lake Trummen. The organizer's website states that VXO Ultrafest is taking a break after five years; no event in 2027 has been confirmed.

description: Lerumsloppet is a community celebration and running race organised by the non-profit association Lerum Friidrott, with any surplus going back to its youth activities. The event offers several distances, from 250 metres up to 10 kilometres, and is a popular spring goal for runners of all ages. The start and finish are at Bagges Torg in Lerum, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good service and great prizes. Lerumsloppet is an annual tradition that attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Long course – 10 km
Short course – 5.1 km
Little Lerum Race – 3.3 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday evening from 16:00 to 19:00 at the former Elgiganten premises by Bagges Torg, or on race day from 09:30 at the race-bib tent. All courses start at Brobacken next to Bagges Torg, except for Lerum Energiloppet, which starts at Bagges Torg. Water stations are located at Vattenpalatset and at the 5.5 km mark on the 10 km course. Changing rooms, showers and secure storage are available near the event centre in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset. Cycling, taking public transport or carpooling is recommended because of limited parking and the large crowds. Around 55 course marshals and guides are stationed along the course. Information about start times, parking, changing facilities, race bibs and results is available on the event website. Registration is via EQ Timing; a club discount and transfer of entry are mentioned for 2025.

name: Tveide Rundt
price_range: 200 kr for 10 km; barneløpet er gratis
description: Tveide Rundt is a fun run starting and finishing in Birkenesparken. The course has been officially measured and certified at 10 km, and the race takes place on the last Sunday in April. It is a great event for everyone aged 13 and over, with attractive raffle prizes and gift cards for podium finishers. Birkenesparken Rundt is also held—a free 1 km children’s race for children aged 6 to 12, with a medal for everyone.
course_highlights: Officially measured and certified 10 km course
Start and finish in scenic Birkenesparken
1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone
additional: Schedule: The kiosk opens at 11:00. Tveide Rundt 10 km starts at 12:00. Birkenesparken Rundt 1 km starts at 12:10. Attractive raffle prizes for all runners and gift cards for podium finishers. The children’s race is free, and all children receive a medal. Birkenesparken Rundt is a free 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone. The listed schedule has the kiosk opening at 11:00, the 10 km starting at 12:00, and the children’s race at 12:10.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://landsjonrunt.se/): 2027-04-25 — "25 April 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-25)

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a lovely trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some off-trail terrain, offering a nature-rich and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and welcomes runners in various classes, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser, SK Graal, looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and off-trail terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: The start and finish are at Graalstugan. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each class and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing rooms and showers are available, with limited space. There is a cafeteria near the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 SEK. Clubs may be invoiced when registering more than three participants. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. Timing is electronic, and finishers receive a medal according to the 2026 information; the 2027 terms have not yet been confirmed.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race held on Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, with the start and finish at Fisksjöäng. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting at 11:00 and 12:00, respectively. The course offers a wonderful experience in nature, with varied terrain, and is easy to reach by public transport. The event is open to young people aged 11 and over when accompanied by a parent or guardian, and has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. All participants receive a medal, refreshments along the course and race timing with a bib.
course_highlights: Trail running on Norra Djurgården through varied natural scenery
Start and finish at Fisksjöäng, near Ropsten metro station
Refreshment stations along the course and chip timing
additional: The start and finish are at Fisksjöäng, a 10-minute walk from Ropsten metro station. Bibs can be collected the Friday before the race at the Icebug store in Stockholm or at the venue on race day. The bib is personal and must be worn visibly on the chest, with the chip unfolded. A medal, refreshments along the course, finish-line services and race timing are included. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Participants receive a discount on Icebug running shoes. A bib with race timing, refreshments along the course, a medal and finish-line services are included. The price information applies to the price periods listed on the organizer’s website and may refer to an edition other than 2027.

name: Trollhättan 5k
description: Welcome to Trollhättan 5K, a fast, officially measured race being held for the fifth time. The course is designed to attract runners looking to run a fast 5K, either as preparation for longer races or to beat their personal best. The course record is already impressive, and it will be exciting to see if it can be broken this year. The race offers a fast course in Trollhättan with great opportunities for good times.
course_highlights: Officially measured, fast 5K course
Suitable as preparation for longer races
Opportunity to break the course record

name: Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp
price_range: 125 kr for barneløp; 275 kr for 5 km
description: The Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp is an annual race held in Kanalparken, Ålgård, Gjesdal. The race features a 5 km loop starting outside Amfi Ålgård and passing through Torgveien, along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge. The scenic course combines an urban setting with beautiful natural surroundings. There is also a 700-metre children’s race. Separate start times are provided for fast runners and everyone else. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting outside Amfi Ålgård
The course runs along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge
700-metre children’s race
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Ålgård Sentrum by Kanalparken. Schedule: 18:00 Children’s race, 700 m; 18:15 5 km SUPER (for runners under 18 minutes); 18:40 5 km for everyone else. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and a finisher’s prize for everyone. Course records from 2025: Men 15:42.8, Women 18:54.1. Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Kanalparken. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.

description: The Värmland Relay in Karlstad is a relay race where teams of 5–15 participants compete together on a flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres long. All teams start and finish at the same time and have two hours to carry the relay baton as far as possible, changing runners after each lap. The relay is open to everyone, and teams can be mixed freely, creating a fun, social competition that promotes community and health. There is an awards ceremony after the race, and light refreshments are available on site. First-time participants buy a team baton featuring their team logo, which is used at every competition.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres per lap
Asphalt surface
Runners change over with the relay baton in the exchange zone by the arena
additional: Each team must buy a baton featuring its team logo in its first year, for 500:-. After the race, results can be engraved on the baton for a fee. Team leaders collect race bibs, chips and the baton at the arena. Paid parking is available at Sundstabadet. Changing rooms and showers are available at Idrottshuset. The card-payment refreshments stand opens at 16:30. Medical services and toilets are available at the arena. Teams may bring their own tents and beach flags to decorate the arena. Teams consist of 5–15 participants. Runners change after each lap, and the same person may not run multiple laps in a row. The baton costs 500 kr in the first year (750 kr for late registration).

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar 15-17 km

description: Pop up Run Åkulla Beech Forests is a magical spring trail run in Åkulla, where the greenery is in full bloom and nature is teeming with life. The race offers a fairytale-like run past charming little lakes, Bexell’s Talking Stones, and through the beautiful beech forest. With a distance of 15–17 km and several pace groups, it suits both experienced and recreational runners looking to make memories for life. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm.
course_highlights: Run through Åkulla’s beech forest
Pass charming little lakes
Pass Bexell’s Talking Stones
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. There are 2–3 different pace groups. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating it is available. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm, at participants’ own expense. Meeting at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. Lunch afterwards is optional and paid for by participants. The organizer recommends carpooling and can help coordinate it.

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: RISEN-loppet is an annual running race organized by Genarps IF, starting and finishing at Ekevallen sports ground in Genarp. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10.7 km. The 5 km route runs mostly on asphalt through the village, while the 10.7 km route is split between the village and Risen Nature Reserve. The course is challenging, with steep elevation changes, and the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup. Participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug at the finish. There are water stations along the course, followed by an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is 95% asphalt and 5% natural trail through the village
The 10.7 km course runs 50% through the village and 50% in Risen Nature Reserve
Steep elevation changes on both distances
additional: Electronic timing, with gun time from the start signal. Race numbers must be collected on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly on the chest. Water and energy drinks are available at 3 km and 8 km (water and squash). At the finish, water, squash, recovery drink (Gatorade), and bananas are available. Rådjursloppet, a 700 m race for children up to age 9, starts at 12:15. All participants receive a medal, and registration is available on site at no charge. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of SEK 100, payable via Swish. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30, after the children's race. All participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug; gold mugs go to approximately the first 25% of finishers in each distance, and silver mugs to the rest. A children's race of approximately 700 metres is also offered. Previous editions have started and finished at Ekevallen sports ground; details of registration and prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: 1. mailøpet
description: Welcome to the 64th May 1st race in Åheim, a traditional cross-country race starting and finishing at Olivinhallen. The race offers several distances for different age groups, from the youngest recruits to seniors and veterans. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a kiosk, cakes, a tombola, and prizes after the race. The senior, junior, and veteran races start at 13:00, while the recruits start at around 14:05.
course_highlights: Cross-country race starting and finishing at Olivinhallen
Several distances from 220 metres to 3,000 metres
Courses for all age groups, including seniors, juniors, veterans, and recruits
additional: The start and finish are at Olivinhallen, which also houses the event office and changing rooms. Payment can be made by bank transfer, VIPPS, or in person, but VIPPS payments are not registered as entries. A paid athletics licence for participants aged 13 and over gives a NOK 20 discount on registration. Traveling trophies are awarded to women and men; they must be won three times to be kept permanently. The event office and changing rooms are at Olivinhallen. Earlier information states that late registration on race day costs an extra NOK 50; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Steinsland Bygdemaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startkontingent er 400 kr. (350 kr for kondismedlem)

description: Steinsland Village Marathon is a long-standing race that starts in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland. The course passes through the scenic municipalities of Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes, with a choice of distances: marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The race offers a wonderful experience in nature, with several refreshment stations along the way and kiosk sales in the start and finish area. An earlier start is available for those who wish to walk the course, and transport and accommodation can be arranged if needed.
course_highlights: The marathon course passes through Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes
10 refreshment stations along the course
Start and finish in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland
additional: Start times: 08:00 marathon for walkers; 09:00 marathon for those who expect to take more than 4.5 hours; 11:00 half marathon for walkers; 12:00 start for the half marathon and 10 km. Kiosk sales are available in the start/finish area. Transport and accommodation can be arranged by contacting the organizer. Distances are marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The start and finish are in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit, with kiosk sales in the start/finish area.

name: Skifjelløpet
description: Skifjelløpet is held annually on May 16, starting at 18:00 from Lillesand IL’s clubhouse. The race is approximately 6 km long and takes place over varied terrain with natural trails and rocky sections. The course is well marked and offers a challenging route that includes steep hills and a rocky section, finishing in front of the clubhouse. Participants can register in advance or on site from 16:30.
course_highlights: Start outside the clubhouse, with an uphill section to the right of the garage
The course crosses the Skifjell rocky section on natural trails
Finish in front of the clubhouse after running around the stadium
additional: Registration is available in advance via Webscorer or on site from 16:30. The course is marked, and a GPX file is available for mobile apps. Participants must run around the stadium before finishing. The organizer’s page lists advance registration via Webscorer and on-site registration from 16:30. Previous editions have been held in May; details for 2027 may differ.

name: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race in Drammen where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour, with the first start at 10:00 on May 1. It is an endurance challenge: runners must complete each loop within an hour to continue, and the last person standing wins. Children’s races are also held on both days, along with an additional race on Sunday where participants run one loop as fast as possible. The festival offers facilities including changing rooms, showers and a kiosk. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory for runs after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop starting every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Running in the dark, with reflective vests and headlamps required after 21:00
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Changing rooms, toilets and showers are available at Ebbestadhallen. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Pizza will be served to participants at 19:30. Start numbers can be bought and sold through Racetracker. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday. Contact: Einar Hagemann (einarhagemann@msn.com).

name: Olavstafetten
description: Olavstafetten is a traditional relay race held on historic ground in Trondheim, starting and finishing at Trondheim Stadion, Øya. The race consists of 10 legs totaling 11,300 metres and is a popular running festival that also includes the “Family and Friends of Olav” category for teams of all sizes. The event features leg times, course records and leg records in all categories, and serves as preparation for the Norwegian Athletics Championships. It is a social, informal relay suited to both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 legs on historic ground, totaling 11,300 metres
Leg times and course records are recorded in all categories
The course follows the Olav route, starting and finishing at Trondheim Stadion
additional: There are dedicated children’s categories (Mini-Olavstafetten and Lille-Olavstafetten) with short legs at the stadium. Family and friend teams can enter the “Family and Friends of Olav” category, with flexible team line-ups. The kiosk opens at 12:00, and prizes are awarded to the children’s and youth categories early in the day. Runners may run multiple legs for multiple relay teams. The main relay starts at 13:00 and is for participants aged 13 and over. A family and friends category is also offered.

name: Råskinnet
description: Råskinnet is a challenging trail race around Sognsvann in Oslo, featuring bogs, trails, steep hills and two water crossings. The race is known for being tough, wet and muddy, and is suitable for the whole family, with separate distances for children and young people. Everyone who finishes can call themselves a true Råskinn. The event has a long tradition and is met with great enthusiasm by participants and volunteers.
course_highlights: Two crossings of Sognsvann, with water reaching thigh or chest height
Steep hills in old ski jumps from 1942 (Kollbakkene)
The course’s most beautiful section, with old-growth forest and bogs by Godbekken
additional: Race bibs are sent by SMS and must be collected at the start area no later than one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available in the basement at NIH; bring your own padlock. There is free parking at Sognsvann and paid parking at NIH. Bags and luggage can be stored in an unattended tent at the venue. Råskinnet’s 10 km race starts in waves according to expected finish time (from 13:30 to 13:50). The children’s races, Knøttetassen and Råtassen, have separate start times at 11:45 and 12:20–12:35. Distances: 900 m for ages 6–9, 3 km for ages 10–15 and 9 km from age 15. Starts are divided into waves. Sognsvann is accessible by metro line 5.

name: Nupen halvmaraton
description: The Nupen Half Marathon in Harstad is a long-standing race that marks the start of the season for the local running community. The race takes runners through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord and offers a great half-marathon experience for both local and visiting runners. Runners of all ages and levels come together for a social and sporting day in early May.
course_highlights: Half marathon through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord
Season opener for Harstad’s running community
The race takes place over varied terrain with great views
additional: Kasfjord is approximately 12 km from Harstad. The distance information is confirmed for 2026; information about 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Esefjorden Rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med heilårslisens

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med eingongslisens ( kr.30)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startpengar konkurranse stafett kr 100,- Stafett 11-12 år (f. 2015 og 2014)

description: Esefjorden Rundt is a beautiful 8.5 km road race on asphalt, with no major elevation changes, around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes. The race starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds, near the centre of Balestrand. The event has a long tradition and attracts recreational runners and competitive runners of all ages, with a festive atmosphere and beautiful scenery, including the mountains Tjugatoten and Keipen around the fjord. Participants can take a shuttle boat from the centre of Balestrand to the start area, making for a unique experience.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course with no major elevation changes
Starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds
The course goes around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes, with beautiful mountain views
additional: Shuttle boats run between Holmen (Balestrand town centre) and Tjugum (the start area) from 09:00 to 16:00. Boat transport ends at 16:00. Shuttle boat tickets cost NOK 80 for adults, NOK 40 for children under 15, and NOK 200 for a family. Parking is available at the finish area, in the town centre, at Tjugum Church and at Bygdahuset. The relay competition has three legs, with a map available. Race numbers must be collected at Tjugum Church within the specified times. A licence is required for participants aged 13 to 80, with a one-time licence available when registering. Recreational and competitive categories. A shuttle boat from Holmen in Balestrand town centre to Tjugum is an option; the finish area at Balahaugen is about 1 km from the town centre.

name: SA-løpet
description: SA-løpet is an open and inclusive running event in the beautiful Kulåsparken in Sarpsborg, suitable for all ages and levels. The event offers several distances, both timed and untimed, and focuses on community, personal achievement, and the joy of running. It is well organized, with dedicated volunteers, good safety measures, and accessibility, and aims to give all participants a positive experience. Welcome to an active day filled with smiles and the true joy of running!
course_highlights: Course in the beautiful Kulåsparken, Sarpsborg
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Safe, well-organized event with a clear course
additional: The start and finish are in Kulåsparken. The children's race starts at 10:00, the 10 km starts at 10:30, and the 2.5 km and 5 km start at 10:35. Race numbers are handed out only on race day from 08:00. Toilets are available in the Service House in Kulåsparken. Bag storage is provided during the race. Participants must be 11 years or older to take part in the timed races; younger participants may take part without timing. Registration is listed as open from 1 February to 29 April 2027, with late registration on 30 April and until the race starts on 1 May. Timed categories have an age limit of 11; younger participants may take part without timing or in the children's race.

name: Heim FrontYard Ultra
description: Heim Front Yard Ultra is a unique ultrarace that combines speed and endurance in a social, informal atmosphere. The race takes place on a 3 km loop with a variable time limit per lap, and participants must complete each lap faster than the previous one to continue. The race starts at Sodvinhallen in Ånesøyan, and the course features a mix of gravel and asphalt with approximately 20 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event is suitable for anyone looking for a challenge in an inclusive setting, with light refreshments and facilities available.
course_highlights: 3 km loop with approximately 20 metres of elevation gain per lap
The course is 50% gravel and 50% asphalt
Start and finish at Sodvinhallen, with access to changing rooms and toilets
additional: The race starts with 30 minutes for the first lap, after which the time is reduced by one minute per lap. Light refreshments are offered during breaks. Parking is available at Sodvinplatået or by the community centre. Spaces are limited. Toilets and changing rooms are available, and light food is served during breaks. All participants receive a medal.

name: Backyard Lampeland Ultra
description: Backyard Lampeland is a unique ultrarace held in Lampeland, Flesberg. The race consists of a gently rolling 6.7 km loop run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of twelve laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start wins the race. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to participation, and offers a rest area, refreshments and changing rooms. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who run the ultra distance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Gently rolling 6.7 km loop per lap
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total
The race starts every hour on the hour
additional: Bringing your own cup is mandatory. A reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap. Baked goods, snacks, coffee, water and sausages are served after the seventh lap. A rest area and changing rooms are available in the hall. Maximum 500 participants. Race bib collection is Friday 15–20 and Saturday 08–09:15 at Friluftsbua by Lampeland Hotel, or in the hall at the start from 09:30. Using a race belt for the race bib is recommended. The start and finish are at Skattekista, the school and multipurpose hall in Lampeland. Maximum 500 participants. Bringing your own cup is mandatory; a reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap.

name: Perseløpet 50 km, 100 km, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås school in Hammerås. It features a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop offering good opportunities for fast times. Participants can choose from seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km, including 50 km and the marathon. The race has a unique concept, with a dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap, and a friendly atmosphere where personal records are celebrated by ringing a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to set personal records
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official refreshment station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning split times. Race-bib collection, changing facilities and toilets are at Ås school, less than 100 metres from the start. Free parking is available.

name: Ulfstindmila
description: Ulfstindmila is an annual cross-country race held on 1 May, starting at Tønsvik bridge and finishing at Skittenelv School in Vågnes. Known as the “world’s shortest 10K,” it covers 8.7 km and has a long tradition dating back to 1972. There are two categories: a recreational category without timing and a competitive category. Mini-Ulfstindmila and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are also held for children, with shorter distances adapted for the youngest participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the beautiful Tønsvik Valley
Starts at Tønsvik bridge and finishes at Skittenelv School
The race is 8.7 km long and is known as the world’s shortest 10K
additional: Ulfstindmila has two categories: a recreational category without timing and a competitive category. Mini-Ulfstindmila (approx. 2.5 km) and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are held for the youngest children. The race has been held annually since 1972, with a few exceptions. Previous editions have offered changing facilities, parking, a café and an awards ceremony at Skittenelv School. The organizer has also offered transport for bags from the start to the finish. Practical information and prices listed for 2025 may change for 2027.

name: Konradløpet 2027
location: Velledalen, Sykkylven, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
location: Gurkbänken, Vessigebro, Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a scenic trail-running race that takes you on a unique journey through Ätradalen, with views of the Ätran, birdsong and lush deciduous forest. The race is held in central Vessigebro at Gurkbänken and offers 5 km and 10 km classes, for runners both with and without dogs. It’s a perfect race for anyone who wants to experience Halland’s beautiful nature in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A unique journey through Ätradalen
Views of the Ätran and birdsong
Runs through lush deciduous forest
additional: Classes are available for runners both with and without dogs. The race is held at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The start and finish are at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The published race information applies to 2 May 2026 and does not confirm the date of 1 May 2027.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultrarun held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosa River. The aim is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour allowed per lap. Participants can start again every hour if they have completed the lap. It is a festive, social race with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the event. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and attractive medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to completing multiple laps
700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free Umara silicone cup at bib collection. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, sandwiches and sweets are provided at each lap checkpoint. In the team competition, the three best results from each club count. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is sold out. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches, sweets and food are served during the race. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a scenic trail race that winds through the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the arrival of spring in a beautiful setting rich in wildlife. The event welcomes both families with children and adults who want to combine running with nature experiences. Nordens Ark is a non-profit foundation that works to protect endangered animals and their habitats, giving the race an especially meaningful purpose.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Eco Park and its scenic surroundings
Run in a beautiful, wildlife-rich setting by Åbyfjorden
Trail running suitable for families with children and adults
additional: The 2026 edition of Nordens Ark TrailRun has been cancelled. The park is cashless; payment is by card or Swish. The park has a café and food outlets during the peak season. The park is open daily, with opening hours varying by season.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2027 in Strandbjörket, Växjö. This is a running festival for the whole family, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners. The courses offer a scenic running experience featuring asphalt, forest roads and beautiful views around Lake Växjö and the Bokhultet Nature Reserve. Växjöloppet is a traditional, friendly race that puts the joy of exercise and community at its heart.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket, with the first kilometre on asphalt
A scenic route through the Bokhultet Nature Reserve, mostly among deciduous trees
The final 3.5 km on asphalt around Lake Växjö, with a shared finish on Lagunvallen
additional: There are water stations on the 10 km course (4 stations) and the 21.1 km course (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers four different distances for younger runners, with no timing. Participants receive a race bib, medal and fruit, or a T-shirt and certificate, depending on the distance. The finish line is on Lagunvallen, approximately 300–400 metres from the finish at Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet is not timed. Registration and payment for the children’s races take place on site at Lagunen in Strandbjörket.
