name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular half-marathon that runs through central Stockholm, starting and finishing at Strömbron, near the Royal Palace and the Parliament House. The course is 21,098 metres long and offers a fast, scenic route through the districts of Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The race is an annual tradition that attracts runners from across the country and offers a unique opportunity to run through Stockholm’s historic and beautiful urban surroundings. The race starts at 15:30, and after the finish there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Royal Palace and Strömbron
Fast course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Clearly marked kilometres and police/officials at every intersection
additional: The expo and race-number pickup take place in Kungsträdgården in the days before the race. Race numbers are printed on site at the expo. The metro is the easiest way to get to the event area. After the race, there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. Race confirmation is sent by email from mid-August. The first start is provisionally at 15:30. Participants may start from the year they turn 17.

name: Midnattsloppet (Malmö)
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is a festive, high-energy running experience taking place on 28 August 2027. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts late in the evening, creating a unique nighttime atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, with a carnival atmosphere, cheers from the crowd and music along the course. There is also the option to take part in costume races and corporate competitions, making Midnattsloppet a memorable and social experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The race runs through central Malmö’s streets in a festival-like atmosphere
Late-evening start times create a unique nighttime running experience
Music and activities along the course create a carnival atmosphere
additional: Costume races start at 21:12 for 10 km and 22:36 for 5 km. Corporate and team competitions are available to strengthen community and workplace wellbeing. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes, with a cutoff after 6.6 km at 22:27. Race packs, shirts and wellness allowances via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits are available. After the race, an After Run with wraps and drinks is offered at a hotel from 23:00 to 01:00. The 10 km starts from 21:00 and the 5 km from 22:30. Costume starts are available for both distances. A team competition is available for the 10 km and gives a discount of 50 kr per person. Race packs are collected at the chosen Stadium store; a medal can be purchased as an add-on.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a well-known city race in Sweden’s southernmost city, Trelleborg, with a measured course offering both 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walk or Nordic walk. The race starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken, providing a lovely, spectator-friendly setting. Trelleborgsloppet is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, and participants can enter team competitions and prize draws for an extra chance to win. The event is marked by a sense of community and fun, with a focus on making the race enjoyable for all participants.
course_highlights: Measured city course with gun time
Starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken
Course through an urban setting, with cultural landmarks and parks along the way
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Östervångsstadion no later than 45 minutes before the start, or the day before in the lobby of Söderslättshallen. Changing facilities are available at Söderslättshallen, with clothing transport to the finish. Timing uses a disposable chip (Neptron), and gun time is used. Late registration is available online until 45 minutes before the start and on site for an additional fee. A team competition is available, with extra prizes for groups of at least 8 participants. There is also a 5 km distance for walking and Nordic walking. Participants can compete individually or as part of a team.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers an enjoyable competition setting for runners of different ages and ability levels, with the option to register late on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and membership benefits, such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The course runs along the River Lagan in Strömsnäsbruk.
Previous editions have offered distances of 10 km and 4.8 km.
Children’s and youth categories have been included in previous editions.
additional: Late registration is available on race day until one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for the youngest children, youth, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 16 augusti - 21 augusti (10.00/13.00) 695 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro that challenges participants to run as far as they can in three or six hours in the scenic Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. The course is a beautiful loop of approximately 2.4 km, mostly on gravel paths with a few bridges, close to the city centre. The event is a celebration of running, focusing on endurance and community, where participants can take on a unique challenge and aim for personal distance records. There is also a KidsRun for the youngest runners. The event is open to all ages and offers a wonderful day filled with the joy of running.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain
Start/finish on cobblestones, with a shorter loop for the final 15–30 minutes
additional: Start times: 6-hour race starts at 11:00, 3-hour race starts at 14:00, KidsRun starts at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place before each start. Timing is recorded using a transponder, which is loaned to participants and must be returned after the race. There is no timing for the KidsRun. At the finish, the distance is measured precisely using a measuring wheel. Water and energy supplies are available along the course, including sports drink, bars, fruit, coffee and more. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. Toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km on the loop. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration and discounts for young people and members of certain running clubs are available. The timed races are 3 and 6 hours long. The KidsRun is for children born in 2015 or later and covers either one full lap or a shorter 700-metre distance.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a festival for both competitive recreational athletes and casual runners looking to challenge themselves in three different events: skiing, cycling and running. The running event offers distances of 21 km and 12 km, as well as children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m. Kraftloppet focuses on health and community, and offers the opportunity to complete a Kraftklassiker by taking part in all three events during the same calendar year.
course_highlights: Running distances of 21 km and 12 km, plus children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m
Recreational races with both shorter and longer distances for different ages and ability levels
Part of the Kraftklassiker, which includes skiing, cycling and running in the same year
additional: The Kraftklassiker rewards participants who complete Kraftloppet skiing, Kraftloppet cycling and Kraftloppet running during the same calendar year. Registration is available via links on the registration page. Contact Bergsbyns SK by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com. The organizer’s published information lists the running event on 29 August 2026; it does not confirm the date of 28 August 2027.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running is a trail race held in Gällivare, starting and finishing at Hellnerstadion. The event offers three distances: 22 km, 10 km and 2 km, all featuring varied terrain and elevation changes that challenge runners of different levels. K22 is a demanding test with 800 metres of elevation gain and beautiful views of Sarek and Kebnekaise, while K10 and K2 offer shorter but still challenging courses. The race is well organised, with safety measures, aid stations, prizes for the fastest runners and a prize draw open to all participants.
course_highlights: K22: 22 km with 800 metres of elevation gain, a mix of trails and paved roads, highest point at 823 metres above sea level
K10: 9.6 km with 240 metres of elevation gain, a mix of gravel and trails, turnaround point at Femmanvägen
K2: 2.1 km trail loop around Hellnerstadion with 60 metres of elevation gain, a fast and manageable distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Hellnerstadion from 08:00 to 09:30. All participants must cross the finish line or notify a race official if they withdraw. Aid stations along K22 and K10 offer water and Umara sports drink. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hellnerstadion. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at 13:00 for K10 and K22, including a mountain prize for K22. All K2 finishers receive a medal. Live results and split times will be published via a link on race day. The registration page states that registration is through MittLopp.se and that registration on race day is not possible. Current prices and distances for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Røykenmila 2027
price_range: 400 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for deltakere under 16 år og Minimila

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Vi øker prisene med kr 100 et par uker før av hensyn til anslag på bestilling av startnummer med chip.

tiers.description: Alle deltakere under 16 år løper gratis. Minimila er gratis.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Aktivitetsløypa som Hyggen Speidergruppe setter opp koster kr 100 per familie (Vipps ved oppmøte).

description: Røykenmila is a challenging trail race in Kjekstadmarka, taking place on Sunday, 29 August 2027. The race offers scenic surroundings with gravel roads and trails, and is suitable for the whole family, with activities and a market day. It is a social event aiming to encourage exercise and support good causes in the local community. The start and finish are at Kjekstad farm. Distances of 5 km and 10 km are offered, as well as the Mini Mile for children.
course_highlights: Trail race through scenic surroundings on gravel roads and trails
Water station on the 10 km course at Haukelia, about halfway around the route
Start and finish at Kjekstad farm, about a 15-minute walk from Røyken station
additional: The Mini Mile starts at 11:30, with prizes for all children. Family activity trail with a quiz and canoeing. Several stalls and entertainment throughout the day. Free treatment and storage of valuables for participants. Course marshals ensure the routes are clearly marked and safe. Strollers can be used on the Mini Mile and activity trail, but a child carrier backpack is recommended. Registration for the 2027 edition has not yet opened. The activity trail costs NOK 100 per family. The organiser says all proceeds will be donated to good causes.

name: Norgestesten 2027 2
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and simple running event held in Jessheim, with a mass start and many experienced pacers. The course is a flat 3,146-meter loop, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Distances range from an 800-meter children’s race to a half marathon, and the event focuses on community and an enjoyable running experience. Proceeds support sports for children and young people in the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-meter loop
Mass start with pacers at several paces
The race is held in Jessheim, with convenient logistics and parking nearby
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 m long. Self-service bib pickup is available from 09:00 in the start area. Toilets are available at Jessheim Friidrettsstadion and in the ice and multi-purpose hall. A table for runners’ own drinks is provided at the start, along with water and sports drink along the course. The half-marathon cutoff time is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Mass start with pacers. The train station and parking are approximately 300 meters from the start. Proceeds support sports for children and young people.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses of 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses available as GPX files with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect. Maps and GPX files are available for the courses.

name: Terrengløp i Smidalen
organizer: Nidelv IL Friidrett og Nidelv IL Ski
description: Terrengløp i Smidalen is an accessible cross-country race for children and young people in grades 1 to 7, organized by Nidelv IL Friidrett og Ski in collaboration with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. The race takes place on a loop of approximately 1,000 meters, with distances adapted to each grade level. All participants start together, and the event encourages well-rounded training and competition in an inclusive environment. It is an important offering for children at Nidelv IL and a popular event with strong participation.
course_highlights: A roughly 1,000-meter cross-country loop
Race distance adapted by grade: grades 1–3 (1 lap), grades 4–5 (2 laps), grades 6–7 (3 laps)
All participants start together
additional: The races are held several times a year, with a focus on children and young people at Nidelv IL. Coaches and team leaders are encouraged to prioritize participation over their own training. The event is part of a sponsorship agreement with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. Details about the course and laps come from coverage of the 2026 edition; the information does not confirm that the 2027 edition will follow the same format.

name: Arnaløpet
price_range: 170-600 kr (+ lisens); gratis for barn 0–12 år

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Arnaløpet is a long-running race that was first held in 1977 on a challenging 13 km course. Since 1984, the course has run around Haukelandsvatnet, and since 1988 there has also been a shorter 3.4 km family course. The event is a major family gathering in Arna, combining competition and social activities, including music and a warm-up before the start. The race is suitable for both children and adults, with free entry for children under 12.
course_highlights: Course around Haukelandsvatnet
3.4 km family course
Historic course starting at Londalskrysset (former route)
additional: The Family Race starts at 19:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:30. The registration deadline for family and individual entries is Monday, August 31 at 18:30. Registration is online only. Race numbers can be collected at Øyrane Torg and Espelandshallen before and on race day. There will be music, socialising and a warm-up before the start. Many great gift prizes will be drawn using race numbers. Participants must use different race numbers when registering for both courses. The stated distances, prices and start times are from the 2026 edition and may differ in 2027. In 2026, the family course started at 19:00 and the 10 km race at 19:30.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children and a sociable atmosphere with team registration and a picnic bag. The course is hilly and passes through beautiful natural surroundings in the area around Ymergården, making the event both challenging and scenic. It is a popular wellness activity for individuals and teams, with a focus on community and health.
course_highlights: 5 km run/walk on walking-friendly trails in hilly terrain
10 km run on hilly trails and roads between Ymer and Kype, with a new route
Lilla Blodomloppet — a child-friendly course where children can run, skip or walk
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event until one hour before the start, for an increased fee. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Late registration at the event area opens at 16:00. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 700 metres for children up to 12 years old. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/boras/): 2027-08-30 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 30 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-30)

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 4
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances, from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, and includes shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadium for most races. Participants use the same race number throughout the series, and the event is open to children, teenagers, and adults.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden, 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden, 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races are held at different locations in Sørum, with Stomperud Stadium as the main venue. The meeting point is listed as Stomperud Stadium, Lørenvegen 2, 1923 Sørum. The distance, start time, and registration details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

description: Blodomloppet in Halmstad is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings participants together in teams and ends with a group picnic. It combines exercise with important civic engagement and has a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in scenic Tylösand
Lilla Blodomloppet for children and young people
Water stations along the course
additional: You can register individually up to race day, 1 September. Start places are sold only through the website. Companies or teams can rent a tent by the finish area, which has a sea view. Food, drinks and ice cream can be purchased from kiosks and food stands at the start. The race ends with a group picnic. Changing facilities, toilets and storage are available at the event area. The race is scheduled for 31 August 2027. Registration is not yet open, and price information is provisional.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/halmstad/): 2027-08-31 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 31 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-02)

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural event through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to everyone; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the event, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km route from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions
additional: The event is non-competitive and open to everyone to run, walk, roll or dance. The start is by the sculpture Protest at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to foster a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 says the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg. Dates and times for 2027 are not specified in the sources.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 7. løp - Essoskogen
price_range: Sesongkort: 900–1200 kr ved påmelding innen 31.12.2026; deretter 960–1260 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing via EQ Timing. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. Season-pass holders collect their race number at the first race; individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish right by the car park in Essoskogen
Two distances: 3 km (one lap) and 5.6 km (two laps)
After 200 metres, the course turns sharply right and runs down along the edge of the field
additional: Electronic timing via EQ Timing. Season-pass holders collect their race number at the first race; individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level. The season pass offers a discount, and race numbers are handed out at the first race. Start at 18:00. Registration is available with a season pass or for individual races.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vaxjo/): 2027-09-01 — "1 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-01)

name: Knarvikmila 2027 - Sparebanken Norge Stafetten
description: Knarvikmila is a long-standing running event that has grown since 1983 into a major community celebration featuring both sports and cultural activities. The event runs over several days and includes various races, seminars, concerts and family activities. The Sparebanken Norge Relay is a social and intense relay with five short legs, perfect for team-building and having fun together. The start and finish are at Knarvik Stadium, with good facilities such as changing rooms, showers and baggage storage in Nordhordlandshallen. After the relay, participants gather in the hall for food and mingling, with an awards ceremony for the top teams.
course_highlights: The relay consists of 5 legs between 400m and 1700m
Start and finish at Knarvik Stadium, with the relay exchange near the stadium
The course goes through Knarvik ungdomsskule, the car park, Juvikstølen and Brekkeløypa
additional: Race numbers and the relay baton can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday 16:00 - 17:45. The baton must be returned in the finish area. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. Free parking in the area around the stadium. After the relay, there will be an awards ceremony and a social gathering with food and mingling at Nordhordlandshallen. The event address provided is Knarvik Stadion, 5916 Isdalstø.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
location: Ramsviks Camping, Ramsvik, Sotenäs Municipality, Sweden
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a unique multi-stage trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Ramsvik in Bohuslän. Over three days, participants experience a total of 77 kilometres across varied terrain featuring massive cliffs, narrow forest trails, coastal communities and beautiful beaches. The race offers different start groups for walkers, joggers and runners, making it an experience for all levels. Alongside the race, there are activities for children at Kids Camp and accommodation options close to the sea at Race Village. It is a highlight for anyone looking to combine a challenge with spectacular nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 77 kilometres of trail over three days, in stages
Massive cliffs, narrow forest trails and beautiful beaches
Start groups for walkers, joggers and runners
additional: Participants use the Pace+ app for race tickets, start times, schedules and maps. The official accommodation partner is Ramsvik Stugby & Camping by the sea, where Race Village and post-finish activities are also located. During the race, Kids Camp offers activities for children such as sailing, fishing and a visit to Nordens Ark. Race Village is located at Ramsviks Camping. Accommodation is booked separately; Ramsvik offers accommodation packages with a cottage, breakfast and dinner. Kids Camp is available for children aged 6 and over.

name: Knarvikmila Halvmaraton
location: Knarvik Stadion, Knarvik, Alver, Vestland, Norway
description: Knarvikmila Half Marathon is being held for the 17th time and offers a beautiful, traffic-free course consisting of four laps of a 5.275 km route, with the start and finish at Knarvik Stadium. The course runs on asphalt and gravel, through the beautiful natural surroundings of Brekkeløypa and around Knarvik. There are 12 drink stations along the way, clear course markings, around 20 course marshals and Red Cross personnel on site. After finishing, participants receive water and bananas. Prizes are awarded to class winners, with cash prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course, starting and finishing at Knarvik Stadium
Asphalt and gravel course through Brekkeløypa
12 drink stations along the way
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen, which is open Friday at 16:00, Saturday at 09:30 and Sunday at 09:00. Late registration is possible but should be avoided. It takes place at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday, Saturday and Sunday during the specified hours. Free parking is available at several locations in Knarvik, with parking attendants on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. The Red Cross and an event doctor will be on site for emergencies. Waste and recycling stations are available. Knarvikmila T-shirts are also available for purchase when registering and at the hall. Drink stations are provided along the course. The half marathon has a minimum age of 15 and is part of FjordViking.

name: Numedalsløpet 2027
organizer: Lyngdal IL, Svene IL og Flesberg IL
description: Numedalsløpet 2027 is a traditional race first held in 1936, making it one of the oldest sporting events in Numedal. The race follows easy forest terrain for approximately 12 km from Høgheim in Lyngdal to Flesberg community centre. It is an inclusive event for both competitive runners and recreational participants, organised in cooperation by Lyngdal IL, Svene IL and Flesberg IL. The race offers opportunities to enjoy nature and community, and has grown into a popular event attracting participants from across the region.
course_highlights: 12 km route on easy forest terrain
Start at Høgheim in Lyngdal and finish at Flesberg community centre
384.4 metres of elevation gain on the course
additional: The untimed recreational run starts from 11:30. The race and timed recreational run start at 13:00. The event is organised in cooperation by Lyngdal IL, Svene IL and Flesberg IL. The race and timed recreational run start at 13:00. The untimed recreational run starts from 11:30. The registration deadline is Thursday, 2 September 2027.

name: Vestfold Maraton
description: Vestfold Marathon is an inclusive running event that encourages recreational runners of all ages to be physically active, starting in Larvik and finishing at Jahn Teigens plass in Tønsberg. The event offers both a full and half marathon, as well as a relay with multiple legs, and emphasizes physical activity and social interaction. The courses are officially measured by Kondis, and the relay format allows everyone to take part, regardless of ability. The event creates a running celebration from Larvik to Tønsberg, with beautiful natural scenery along the way.
course_highlights: Start at Hegdal industrial area in Larvik and finish at Jahn Teigens plass at Tønsberg brygge
Relay with 8 legs for the marathon and 4 legs for the half marathon
The courses are officially measured by Kondis and include varied legs through urban and natural areas
additional: Relay teams can be women’s, men’s, or mixed teams, with at least one woman per team. Wheelchair racing with spiked wheels is permitted when registering. Water, bananas, and sports drinks are available at several aid stations. Changing rooms with showers are available at Tønsberg guest harbor. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Nortura Tønsberg or at the start venue on race day. No refunds are given for withdrawals or failure to finish. Photographers document the race, and images may be used for marketing. Anti-doping rules apply. The course and leg details provided refer to the 2026 information and may change for 2027. Registered participants can take part individually or as a relay team.

name: Jentemila
organizer: Jentemila, Christiania Glasmagasin og Anton Sport
description: Jentemila is a long-running, accessible girls’ race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on the first weekend of September. The race brings together thousands of girls of all ages and fitness levels for a weekend of running, walking or jogging 5 or 10 km, alongside entertainment, shopping, gifts and a well-stocked goodie bag for all participants. The event offers a unique running festival with music, competitions and socialising, and wraps up with bubbles and a lively atmosphere after the finish. Jentemila welcomes everyone to an inclusive and magical experience at Bislett Stadium.
course_highlights: A route on asphalt, gravel and trails, with challenging and varied sections
Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at iconic Bislett Stadium, with Oslo streets closed to traffic
additional: Participants are divided into waves based on their expected finish time and distance. Waves start two minutes apart. It is possible to collect race bibs for several people by showing a QR code or giving their names. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish in exchange for a voucher. Medals are available to pre-order or buy at the stadium. Bag storage is available; luggage tags are attached to race bibs. After-run drinks are available to participants over 18. Discounts are offered for registering without a T-shirt and for group registrations (more than 4 people). A 15% student discount is available by sending proof of student status to the organiser after registering. Race bibs can be selected with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a 100 kr discount. Groups of more than four get a 50 kr discount per participant. The 10 km is listed as starting at 14:00, and the 5 km and 10 km waves start two minutes apart.

name: Drammen Halvmaraton
description: Drammen Half Marathon is a spectacular running adventure that takes participants around a lightning-fast 10-kilometer loop twice. The race takes place in Drammen, Buskerud, and offers a fast, scenic course suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. The event has a limited number of race bibs to ensure a good experience for all participants. In addition to the half marathon, a children’s race and other running activities are held under the same umbrella.
course_highlights: The course consists of a fast 10-kilometer loop run twice
The race goes through central Drammen and the surrounding areas
A limited number of race bibs ensures a good running experience
additional: A green race bib indicates that a medal was purchased in advance. A maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for the Drammen Half Marathon. A children’s race, Minimaraton, is also held on the same day. No phone number is provided for contact, but inquiries are answered by email and through the contact form. The organizer states that a maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for 2026. Race times can be followed live via Ultimate Sport Service LIVE.

name: Balestrand Trailrun
description: Balestrand Trailrun is a race run on a circular course starting and finishing at Kreklingen Stadium in Balestrand. The race follows beautiful trails and offers a scenic experience in the area. There are both competitive and recreational categories, so both fast runners and recreational runners can take part. The distance is 5.4 km, and the race is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and enjoyable trail run.
course_highlights: Circular course on beautiful trails in Balestrand
Start and finish at Kreklingen Stadium
Terrain with maintained trails and scenic surroundings
additional: The race has both competitive and recreational categories. The start and finish are at Kreklingen Stadium. The race is a 5.4 km circular trail course. Previous races such as Balestrand Opp and Rundt are now combined under Balestrand Trailrun, with a new route from 2025. Previous editions have had a competitive course, a recreational course, and a free mini-run. Course distances and practical information may vary from year to year.

name: Fløymila
description: Fløymila is a fun run held on Flekkerøy in Kristiansand, with distances suited to both children and adults. The event includes a 600-metre children’s race, as well as 5 km and 10 km distances. It is a popular event that brings together many participants for an enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings. Fløymila welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy running on Flekkerøy.
course_highlights: Run on Flekkerøy amid scenic surroundings
Distances for children and adults: 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
A fun run with a great atmosphere and broad participation
additional: Distances include a 600 m children’s race, 5 km and 10 km Fløymila. Race bib collection and registration take place at the event. The race attracts many participants and is a fun run focused on community and enjoyment.

name: Nordmarkstravern
description: Nordmarkstravern is a traditional forest race in Nordmarka, Oslo, offering several distances for different ages and ability levels. The courses follow trails and gravel roads through some of Nordmarka’s most beautiful areas, with start points at Stryken, Skar, Hammeren and Nordberg school. The event offers everything from short, child-friendly routes to challenging ultra-distances, with an emphasis on clear course marking, refreshment stations and safety, including medical personnel and first aid. The race has an inclusive atmosphere, with categories for runners, people with strollers and wheelchair users.
course_highlights: Heltravern 30 km on trails and gravel roads from Stryken to Kringsjå by Sognsvann
Dobbeltravern 60 km, following the Heltravern course out and back
Kvarttravern 7 km, with 2.5 km on trails and the rest on gravel roads, suitable for children and families
additional: Start times: Dobbeltravern 60 km at 07:30; all other distances at 11:00. Prices include a race bib with timing, marked courses, prizes and category prizes. Bus transport to start areas is provided except for the 30 km, 60 km and 1.2 km distances. Bag transport from start to finish is available for all distances. Food and drink stations along the route. A mandatory NOK 50 licence fee for the Norwegian Athletics Association applies to participants without an annual licence. Registration is binding, but race bibs may be sold or transferred to another participant. Registration prices vary by distance and date. A mandatory one-time licence fee of NOK 50 is added for participants without an annual licence. The entry fee includes timing, marked courses, prizes, bag transport, and food and drink stations. Bus transport to the start areas is included for several distances.

name: Lovundmila
description: Lovundmila is a friendly race on beautiful Lovund, offering several distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and shorter races for children and young people. The race combines scenic surroundings with an inclusive atmosphere and attracts both local and visiting runners. The event is known for its great atmosphere, volunteer effort, and support from the local community. Lovundmila is more than just a race; it is a social event celebrating the joy of running in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race on beautiful Lovund with wonderful scenery
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, and shorter races for children
Great atmosphere with support from volunteers and spectators
additional: Previous editions have started and finished at Lovundmila Flerbrukshall.

name: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet/marsjen
description: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1966, offering beautiful natural surroundings near Rondane. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 9 km walk and a children’s obstacle race, making it family-friendly. The course starts at Rudland Fjellsenter and crosses varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails, forest roads and asphalt, as well as scenic areas such as Frydalen Landscape Protection Area. Welcome to the mountains and to the Adventure in Rondane!
course_highlights: The course passes through Frydalen Landscape Protection Area, with beautiful scenery and reindeer habitat
The course’s longest uphill stretch is approximately 1.3 km long, with 35 m of elevation gain
Varied surfaces include gravel roads, trails, forest roads, marshland and asphalt
additional: The half marathon starts at 12:00, and the 9 km walk starts at 12:20. Late registration is available at the stadium until the start. There are age categories from 11 years old, as well as a family category. There are several aid stations along the course. The terrain includes wet marshland; stepping on tussocks and rocks is recommended for better grip. The start and finish are at Rudland Fjellsenter on Kvamsfjellet. The event also includes the Snipp-Snapp children’s obstacle race. Registration is through the organizer’s website.

name: Herdla Backyard Ultra
description: Herdla Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon that challenges both beginners and experienced runners to test their limits in a unique community. The race is organized by an experienced ultrarunner and focuses on safe participation, good facilities, and a course that gives participants the best possible conditions for success. Participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour, and the race continues until only one runner remains. Herdla Backyard Ultra is not just about winning, but about challenging yourself and sharing the experience with others.
course_highlights: The course is 6.7 km, with varied terrain and 135 metres of elevation gain
The start and finish area are the same for every loop
Each loop must be completed in under an hour, and the next loop starts on the hour, exactly
additional: Each participant receives a bib number and a timing chip for tracking. A reflective vest and headlamp are mandatory in the dark. Support is only allowed in the finish area between loops. The winner receives NOK 5,000, and prizes are drawn based on bib numbers. The race does not end until the last runner completes the final loop. All participants receive a medal. Timing and tracking are provided by Racetracker Norge.

name: Toughest
description: Toughest Oslo 2027 offers an unforgettable obstacle course racing experience in the spectacular terrain of Holmenkollen. The main race covers approximately 8 km with 30–40 varied obstacles, including the iconic Holmenkollen ski slope as the grand finale. Participants can choose between the full main race, a lighter 4 km Xplore course designed for fun and beginners, or a 2 km family-friendly course. The event welcomes everyone from amateurs to elite athletes, with options for fast lanes and penalty rounds to tailor the challenge.
course_highlights: Varied and challenging terrain in Holmenkollen
Approximately 30–40 obstacles of varied size and difficulty
Finish on the legendary Holmenkollen ski slope
additional: Fast lanes are available on selected obstacles for an extra challenge. Penalty rounds allow participants to skip difficult obstacles with a short jog penalty. Registration closes about one week before the event or when capacity is reached. Health care benefits can be used for registration via Benifex & Epassi. The main race has an optional Double Distance add-on of approximately 16 km. Registration closes about one week before the race or when capacity is reached, and prices vary depending on when you register.

name: Jentemila
description: Jentemila is a long-standing, accessible race for girls and women of all ages and fitness levels, held at Bislett Stadium on the first weekend of September. The event offers both 5 km and 10 km distances, and participants can choose to run, walk or jog. There are two days of entertainment, shopping, gifts, competitions and a well-stocked goodie bag for every participant. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy sparkling drinks and celebrate in an inclusive, festive atmosphere. Known as Norway’s friendliest women’s race, Jentemila brings together thousands of participants for a unique running festival.
course_highlights: The courses run on asphalt, gravel and trails, with a challenging and varied profile
Start and finish at Bislett Stadium, with streets in Oslo closed to traffic for the event
Wave starts every 2 minutes, based on the chosen distance and expected finish time
additional: Participants can choose a race bib with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a discount of NOK 100. Groups of more than 4 people receive a discount of NOK 50 per participant. Bag storage is available, with baggage tags included. Medals can be pre-ordered or purchased at the stadium. After the race, participants over 18 can attend an after-run with alcoholic or non-alcoholic drinks. Wave starts are 2 minutes apart, and participants can submit the same expected finish time to run together in the same wave. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish line in exchange for the coupon attached to the race bib. Race bibs can be ordered with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a discount of NOK 100. Groups of more than four receive a discount of NOK 50 per participant. The 5 km and 10 km waves start 2 minutes apart.

name: Stordløpet
description: Stordløpet is a long-standing race organized by Stord Friidrett, a subgroup of Stord Idrettslag, which has a history dating back to 1914. The race takes place at Stord Stadium and brings together runners of various ages and abilities for a running festival in central Leirvik. The event is an important part of local sporting life and offers a great opportunity to take part in a well-organized race with a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Stord Stadium and in central Leirvik
Suitable for runners of all ages and abilities
Part of a local running festival with a great atmosphere
additional: Stord Friidrett also organizes other races, such as Parkløpet, with distances suited to children and young people. The club has members of all ages and offers a broad range of athletics events. A fun run and children's races of 400 or 800 metres have also been held. Information about distances and the course is from previous editions and does not confirm the details for 2027.

name: Lyderhorn Opp 2027
description: Lyderhorn Opp is an annual uphill race organized by Laksevåg Turn og Idrettslag, finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level. The course is approximately 3.8 km long and suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event takes place in scenic surroundings in Bergen, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and a T-shirt. It is a traditional autumn event that brings together runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Uphill race finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level
Course length: approximately 3.8 km
Scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at Sport1 at Vestkanten on Friday, September 4, from 16:00 to 21:00, with a 10% discount on any product. Race bibs can also be collected at the start, but collection in advance is recommended. There is ample parking, but using public transport, walking, or cycling is recommended. First-aid personnel and defibrillators are available along the course. Cash prizes are awarded to the three fastest men and women. Many gift prizes are drawn by race bib number. The organizer says Lyderhorn Opp will return in 2027. Distance and course details are based on previous editions; details for 2027 have not been provided.

name: Melshornløpet 2027
location: Sivert Aarflot-plassen, Volda, Møre og Romsdal, Norway
organizer: Foreininga Melshornets Venner og VTI Friidrett
description: Melshornløpet is an annual uphill race from Volda town centre to the summit of Melshornet, 807 metres above sea level. The course is approximately 7 kilometres long and offers a wonderful experience in nature, with a challenge from fjord to mountain. The race is open to competitive runners, recreational runners and participants in the non-competitive fitness run, with cash prizes in the junior and senior categories. The start is at Sivert Aarflot-plassen in Volda, and the finish is at the summit of Melshornet, with spectacular views of Voldafjorden and the Sunnmøre Alps. All participants receive a medal, and prize draws are held during the awards ceremony in the start area.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km from sea level to 807 metres above sea level
Scenic surroundings from fjord to mountain
Spectacular views of Voldafjorden and the Sunnmøre Alps
additional: The recreational category has a start window from 09:00 to 11:00, while the competitive categories have a mass start at 11:00. All participants in the competitive categories must carry a backpack with the required equipment. Random checks will be carried out at the summit, with a time penalty for missing equipment. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:30 in the start area, and you must be present to win a draw prize. The fitness run is an alternative with no timing or competitive pressure, starting between 09:00 and 11:00. The fitness run supports the Norwegian Cancer Society, and it is possible to shorten the route by starting from Bratteberg school. Recreational starts are between 09:00 and 11:00; the competitive categories have a mass start at 11:00. The recreational category is unranked. Participants in the competitive categories must carry a backpack with the required equipment.

name: Run to the beat powered by Bang & Olufsen 2027
Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description:
The HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon starts at Sundstorget, outside Dunkers Kulturhus. The unique route begins with two kilometres through Helsingborg’s historic and beautiful city centre. You’ll pass historic quarters such as Stortorget and the medieval fortress Kärnan, then continue through the Tågaborg and Maria Park neighbourhoods and the Pålsjö Forest Nature Reserve. The route then finishes through Laröd, down Tinkarpsbacken and along our beautiful seafront promenade, with the sparkling Öresund Strait before you.

The course has only 95 metres of elevation gain, with a hill up towards Kärnan after 2 kilometres and a long downhill towards the sea after 19 kilometres. Running the HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon lets you enjoy everything from the vibrant city centre to peaceful woodland and the sea.

At the finish, you can enjoy your achievement on the wooden deck—and perhaps celebrate with a dip in the Öresund Strait? Afterwards, head to our event area, with activities for the whole family, relatives and supporters.
additional:
START: 09:30, 09:33 & 09:36
DISTANCE: 21,097.5 metres
ELEVATION: 95 metres of elevation gain. 190 metres total (up & down)
SURFACE: approx. 99% asphalt, 1% other
HIGHLIGHTS: City centre, Bergaliden, Slottshagen, Kärnan, Mariastaden, Maria Park, Pålsjö Forest, Laröd, Tinkarsbacken & the Seafront Promenade
NEIGHBOURHOODS: City centre, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Available to download from the website.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is Gothenburg’s largest trail race, offering five challenging distances in beautiful, varied terrain close to the city. The races follow adventurous trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops with fantastic views, mixing technical sections with easy-running stretches. The start and finish are at historic Kvibergs Park, and the courses take you from the outskirts of the city into the wilderness, with lakes and magical forests along the way. After the finish, a convivial AfterRun with food and energy awaits, giving you a chance to celebrate your achievement. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners looking for a true nature challenge near Gothenburg.
course_highlights: A mix of technical and easy-running trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops
Routes past idyllic lakes and magical forests, including historic cairns
Start and finish at Kvibergs Park, with views over Gothenburg and the Säveå valley
additional: Start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shuttle bus from Kviberg. Self-seeding in start groups takes place on site. AfterRun with food and energy after the finish. Live tracking and split times. Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs are distributed on Friday and Saturday before the race. Public transport by tram and bus to Kviberg is recommended. Name changes are possible for a fee until 3 September. A children’s race is available as a supplementary activity. Most races start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shuttle bus from Kviberg. The longer races require, among other things, a water container of at least 0.5 litres, energy supplies and a charged mobile phone.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a challenging and scenic trail run through the forests and countryside around Dammen in Tvärred, just south of Ulricehamn. Participants can choose from three distances: 7 km, 17 km and 27 km, all starting and finishing in the same beautiful area. The course features narrow forest trails, moss-covered rocky sections and magical views over Åsunden, making the race an adventure filled with camaraderie and the joy of running. Hot food is served after the finish, and all participants receive a medal. The youngest runners can take part in a free mini race focused on fun and play.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and hilly terrain
Moss-covered rocky sections and exposed rock slabs
Beautiful views over Åsunden
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred. Parking is available nearby. Food and drinks, music and sun loungers are available on site. Volunteers and an announcer help spectators follow the highlights of the race. Hot food is included for all participants after the finish. The free mini race for children starts at 10:45, with registration on site. Maximum 300 participants. The entry fee is the same for all distances. Reduced fees for children and young people. The Västgötaloppet website lists 5 September 2026 as race day, which differs from the date 4 September 2027 in the competition information.

name: Trondheim Maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.6 km
description: Trondheim Marathon is Norway’s oldest marathon and is held annually on the first weekend of September in central Trondheim. The course runs through the city centre and offers beautiful, spectator-friendly surroundings, with the start and finish at Torvet. The event offers distances for all levels, from children’s races to the full marathon, and also includes relay races. The focus is on public health and the joy of running, with a wide range of training plans and support for participants throughout the year.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Trondheim, with the start and finish at Torvet
The full marathon consists of two laps; the half marathon is one lap
Scenic, spectator-friendly routes extend to Lade and Tempe
additional: Start and finish at Torvet in Trondheim. Relay races have four legs for both the half marathon (4 × 5 km) and the full marathon (4 × 10.55 km). All participants must have a licence, either an annual licence or a one-time licence purchased during registration. Bag storage is available inside City Hall. Pacers adjust their pace to the conditions and inclines. Medical support and first-aid training for race officials are provided. Participants must finish within the time limit to be recorded as having completed the race. The range of distances also includes the 2 km Children’s Marathon, the 600 m Children’s Mini Marathon, and relay races. The half-marathon relay has four 5 km legs, and the marathon relay has four 10.55 km legs.

name: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027
description: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027 is a running event for all ages in Asker, Akershus. The main race is a 9 km trail course for adults, with children’s races starting at 400 metres and up. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and a kiosk is open during the race. This is an inclusive and enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 9 km trail course for adults
Children’s races starting at 400 metres and up
Suitable for both recreational and competitive runners
additional: A kiosk is open during the event. The race is organised by Tofte Fremad IF. A kiosk is open.

name: Gå og løb med Støt Brysterne 5. sep. 2027
Ørestad Half Marathon & 10K
description: Flat half marathon and 10K by the sea on Kalvebod Fælled in Copenhagen. AIMS-certified course, starting and finishing at Naturcenter Amager, 5 minutes from Vestamager Metro. The course is flat, with only around 7 metres of elevation gain, and runs along the coast and through the nature reserve. In 2026, 801 runners from 50 nations finished. The entry fee includes chip timing, a medal and a digital diploma. There is room for around 1,000 runners.
additional: Half marathon starts at 10:00, 10K starts at 10:25. Start and finish: Naturcenter Amager, Granatvej 3, 2770 Kastrup. Price: half marathon DKK 495 (DKK 595 from 22/8-2027), 10K DKK 395 (DKK 495 from 22/8-2027).

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic course along the river promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km courses along the river promenade and the city streets
Certified 5,000 m course measured by an SFIF course measurer
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants; a picnic for 5 people is included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter courses inside the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 people. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to age 12; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.
