description: Backyard Stavanger is a unique ultrarunning event held at Dyrsnes Nature Centre in Stavanger. The race consists of a gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km, run on the hour every hour, with a maximum of 12 laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last person to start wins the race. The event offers a friendly and inclusive atmosphere with a low barrier to entry, welcoming both beginners and experienced ultrarunners. Simple refreshments and places to rest are provided. A headlamp and reflective vest are required for safety.
course_highlights: Gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km per lap
Runs start on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps (80.4 km in total)
Social event with places to rest in a tent and barn
additional: You must bring your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Attaching your bib with a race belt is recommended. Simple refreshments include snacks, coffee, tea, broth and water. Support is not permitted indoors or on the course, only in the start/finish area. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup and a wooden medal for the ultradistance (longer than a marathon). Maximum 210 participants. Your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest are mandatory.

name: Gruemila
description: Gruemila is a challenging 10 km race held in Kirkenær as part of the Grue Half Marathon event. The race features technically demanding forest terrain on 6.7 km loops, where participants can compete for the win or finish for a medal and finisher cap. The event also includes a fast, flat half marathon, considered one of Norway’s fastest courses. This is a great race for both competitive and recreational runners looking for a varied and exciting running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Technically challenging forest terrain on 6.7 km loops
Medal available for completing a loop
Flat and fast half marathon
additional: The race is run on 6.7 km loops through technically challenging forest terrain, with a new start every hour until only one runner remains. Complete one loop for a medal, or compete for a finisher cap and the win.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and levels to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km and 10 km, plus a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages fundraising via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact people can be reached via the specified email address. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. Information about the distances and event is based on previous editions; details for 2027 are not confirmed by the sources.

name: Loddefjordløpet
description: Loddefjordløpet is held at Alvøen Sports Park in Bergen and is an annual race featuring distances including a 5 km and children’s races of 2 km or 600 metres. It is a popular event for both children and adults, with a focus on athletics and recreational running in a welcoming atmosphere. Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which organises the race, also offers a range of training activities for children and young people in the area. For the latest information, follow the race’s Facebook page.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Alvøen Sports Park
Children’s races of 2 km and 600 metres
Held in scenic surroundings in western Bergen
additional: Loddefjordløpet includes both a 5 km race and children’s races over shorter distances. The organiser is Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which also offers athletics training for children and young people. Historical results from previous years are available on the website. Previous editions have offered free children’s races for pupils in grades 1–4, with a medal for participants. Information about the 2027 edition is not provided in the sources.

name: Norgesløpet 2027
description: Norgesløpet 2027 is held as a road race at Jessheim Stadium, with distances of 5 km (Norwegian Championships) and 10 km. The race starts on Kanalveien and finishes inside Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Registration is available in an elite start wave, and pacers are provided for the most popular finish times. The event also includes children’s races with multiple waves for different age groups, creating an enjoyable day with a great atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium
Course along Kanalveien marked with red and white ribbons
Water stations at approximately 5 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Bag storage is available with a baggage tag. Toilets and changing rooms are located in several nearby buildings. Train travel is recommended, with several parking areas nearby. Pacers run with visible flags or T-shirts. Children’s races are held at 11:30 and 14:00, with waves grouped by age. Fantorangen and the NRK Super Bus will be there for families. Children’s races are also held. Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Train travel is recommended; parking costs 50 NOK via Vipps.

description: Skoppums Råeste is a challenging and fun obstacle-course trail race suitable for everyone, from beginners to experienced OCR runners. The race takes place at Skoppum Idrettsplass and features mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, water crossings, muddy streams, tire obstacles, and crawling zones. Participants can choose to run 2.5 km with approximately 15–20 obstacles, or double the distance to 5 km by completing an extra lap. The race is accessible to all and includes timing, but everyone who finishes receives a medal and is considered a winner. There is also a separate MiniRåeste for children under 10, with a shorter obstacle course.
course_highlights: Obstacle-course trail featuring mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, and water crossings
Approximately 2.5 km course with 15–20 obstacles; participants can run 5 km by completing two laps
Accessible race with timing and a medal for all participants
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 for bib pickup. Skoppums MiniRåeste for children under 10 starts at 11:00. Participants can choose a start group based on an expected lap time of under or over 30 minutes. Changing rooms and washing facilities are available, as is a kiosk that accepts payment via Vipps. Parking costs NOK 50 and is paid via Vipps. All participants receive a medal. The course can be walked before the start, but obstacles must not be tested. Timing and medals are provided. Start groups are divided by expected lap time: under or over 30 minutes. The prices found apply to 2027 registration on the page for the 2026 event.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Runfest
description: Runfest is an ambitious three-day road-running festival in Sandnes, the hometown of Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen. The festival will be held for the second time from 30 September to 2 October 2027, with race days on Friday 1 October and Saturday 2 October. Runfest combines elite competition with the joy of running and focuses on public health, physical activity and community. Participants of all ages and abilities are welcome to take part in a wide range of races and activities in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in Sandnes, on the edge of Norway, with start locations suited to the 1500 m, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km distances
Aid stations with sports drink and water approximately every 5 km
Pacers available for several distances to help runners reach their goals
additional: Race numbers can be collected before and on race day; collecting them the day before is recommended to avoid queues. Changing facilities and bag storage are available at Thon Senter Sandnes. The official AfterRun, with a bar, street food, live concert and DJ, will be held on Saturday 3 October. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September as a professional gathering focused on public health. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September 2027. All finishers receive a medal.

name: Áskorun ársins 2026 / We Challenge the Year 2026
Oslo Trail Challenge
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon that takes place in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen, north of central Oslo. The race offers demanding and scenic trails suited to ultrarunners looking for a challenging experience in varied Norwegian forest terrain. The organizer, Langt og Lenge, has extensive experience with ultramarathons and offers a race focused on enjoying nature and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Trail ultramarathon in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen
Varied and demanding forest terrain north of central Oslo
Scenic trails with challenging sections
additional: Previous editions have used GPS navigation on unmarked courses.

name: Austevollsløpet
description: Austevollsløpet hosts a flexible relay for businesses, with up to five participants per team and a total course of approximately 21 km. The race runs from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground, and participants can divide the distance as they wish, making the relay accessible to many. The event creates a festive atmosphere, with spectators cheering along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal. Proceeds from the event go towards the athletics group’s activities and training camps in Austevoll.
course_highlights: A relay course of approximately 21 km from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground
Up to five participants per team, with flexible leg distribution
Spectators along the course with flags and music, and changeover points at food stations approximately every 5 km
additional: A bus leaves Austevoll Secondary School at 11:45 and stops at the changeover stations for drop-off and pick-up. All participants receive a medal. The event is supported by Austevoll Kraftlag as its main sponsor. Teams may have fewer than five participants if they wish. Distance options have varied between editions. In 2026, the business relay cost NOK 1,000 per team, and the Mini-Mini Marathon was free.

name: Tromsø Backyard Ultra
description: Tromsø Backyard Ultra is a unique Arctic ultrarun in the heart of Tromsø, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. The race challenges endurance and tactics, as each loop must be completed within an hour to continue. It is suitable for all levels, whether you want to test your limits or take part in a social and motivating training session. The race takes place on Tromsdalen’s beautiful network of trails, mostly on gravel roads with some asphalt, offering a special experience in Northern Norwegian nature.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop in Tromsdalen
The course is mostly on gravel roads, with some asphalt
Start/finish outside TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
additional: Race bibs must be collected well before the race. Parking is available at Entrance A or Elvestrand Cemetery. Discounted accommodation may be available at Tromsø Lodge and Camping. Participants run one loop every hour and must be ready at the start line when the next loop begins. All starters receive a participant medal. The winners in the women’s and men’s categories are determined after 24 loops. Distances build up over the loops: 4 loops is approximately 26.8 km, 7 loops approximately 46.9 km, 12 loops approximately 80 km, and 15 loops approximately 100.6 km.

name: Nesbyen Backyard 2027
description: Nesbyen Backyard takes place on the first Saturday in October, featuring 6- and 12-hour Backyard Ultra races in beautiful Nesbyen, Hallingdal. The race offers a flat, fast 6.7 km loop that runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail, challenging runners to complete one loop every hour. This unique race combines endurance, tactics and community in a social and motivating atmosphere, with prizes for everyone who completes the race and door prizes from local sponsors. The race starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall at 10:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with less than 30 metres of elevation gain
The course runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail
Flat, fast course through Nesbyen town centre amid beautiful autumn scenery
additional: Start and finish at Nesbyen Sports Hall, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and an indoor lounge. A kiosk with food and drinks is available. The race’s Backyard area serves as a social gathering place between loops. More than 20 door prizes from local sponsors. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the start area. The course is Norway’s flattest Backyard loop, with less than 30 metres of elevation gain. Accommodation is available along the course, including at Hagaled Guesthouse. Starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall on 2 October 2027 at 10:00. Registration via EQ Timing. Prices increase in stages as the registration deadline approaches. Prizes for everyone who completes at least one loop, as well as placement prizes and door prizes.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 745 kr 28 september – 3 oktober – i mån av plats!

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a popular trail race in Borås, offering beautiful and varied terrain in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve. The race has several distances to suit both beginners and experienced trail runners, with challenging hills and lovely views. The start and finish area has a great atmosphere, with music, exhibitors, food and a runners’ lounge. The event has a family-friendly feel, with children’s races and a festival atmosphere in the forest that attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Varied trail running on beautiful paths with challenging hills
Djävulsbacken—a 300 m-long hill with 75 m of elevation gain
Beautiful views at Rya Klint, Fjällsjön and Hestrastugan
additional: Start and finish on the plateau at Rya Åsar, with music, exhibitors, a runners’ lounge and food service. Bib collection on Friday and Saturday. Chip timing, with start groups for elite, fast runners and recreational runners. Bag drop available. Toilets, changing facilities and showers at Borås Camping. Aid stations with Umara sports drink on the 24 km and 12 km courses. Children’s races of 800 m and 1.8 km are available. Children’s races and sanctioned competitions are offered.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path. A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race at Ås School in Eidsvoll, offering a simple and efficient race format focused on fast times. The course is a flat, measured 2,633-meter loop, with distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making it easy to manage nutrition in a personal way. The event offers good facilities, with race bib pickup, changing rooms and toilets inside the school, as well as free parking. Perseløpet is known as a race where many participants set personal records, and runners are encouraged to celebrate by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-meter loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Race from Ås School with facilities including changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at the school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th graders from Feiring School staff an official drink station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås School. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning split times. All distances take place in the same area and use the same weather forecast. Registration is via RaceDays. Race bibs are available for self-service pickup at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The course is AIMS-certified.

name: Steinkjer Skogsmaraton
description: Steinkjer Forest Marathon is a demanding trail race with a tough and challenging course featuring steep climbs and descents. The route follows the beautiful trails of Oftenåsen and gives participants a sense of achievement amid scenic surroundings. The start and finish are at Lerkehaug, by Steinkjer Shooting Range, where facilities include parking, bib collection and bag storage. At the venue, participants can enjoy campfire coffee and freshly made waffles while waiting for the start.
course_highlights: A tough and challenging trail course with steep climbs and descents
The route follows the beautiful trails of Oftenåsen through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Steinkjer Shooting Range, with good facilities and a friendly atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose to race with or without timing in both distances. Bib collection and bag storage are available at the venue. Campfire coffee and freshly made waffles are sold by the fire. There is a water station on the course at Sagkorsen. Half-marathon runners complete two laps of the course, while quarter-marathon runners complete one lap. The start and finish are at Lerkehaug, by Steinkjer Shooting Range. Participants can choose to race with or without timing. The listed prices apply to previous editions and have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: RE-MILA 2027
description: RE-MILA is a fun run for all ages, starting and finishing in central Revetal. Distances include 600 metres for children, 2.5 km for youth, and 5 km and 10 km for adults and youth. The event has wave starts with pacers and follows Kondis’s recommended age-group categories. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to age-group winners and the top runners at each distance. Race numbers can be collected the day before or on race day in Revetal.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Revetal, by the Sport1 store
Wave starts with up to 8 waves and pacers
Free parking in nearby parking garages and open-air parking spaces
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Sport1 store in Revetal on the Saturday before the race from 12:00 to 15:00, or on race day from around 12:00. All participants in the children’s race receive a free T-shirt and medal. Wave starts are 15–30 seconds apart, with the fastest wave first. The official website states that all participants receive a medal. A free T-shirt is mentioned for children’s race participants. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Perseløpet ¤7 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve good times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, with seven distances from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them full control over their nutrition without the need to manage aid-station logistics. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated by ringing the bell at the finish area. Perseløpet is organized by Feiring IL and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table by the course for personal refuelling
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to achieve good times
additional: Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The event has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. Weather forecasts and the course elevation profile are available via the website. Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: Esbjerg City Half 2026 Powered by CRAFT
Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with 300, 600 and 1,500 metres of elevation gain respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance taking runners up the mountain five times. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and demanding trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails in untouched wilderness
Beautiful views by small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children’s race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Transfer of a race entry is possible under the terms listed on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, plus VMX Kids. Trail running shoes are recommended. The website describes the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

description: Bergensløpet celebrates an anniversary with a double running festival in beautiful surroundings in Bergen. The race starts and finishes in historic Nygårdsparken and runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, both on a fast, officially measured course. A free children's race is also held for children up to 11 years old, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The course runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal
Fast, officially measured 5 km course; the 10 km runners complete two laps
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at the collection point and in the clubhouses. The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children's race is approximately 500 metres, free, and has no timing or rankings; all children receive a medal. The autumn edition is listed as taking place on Saturday, 10 October. The date for the 2027 edition matches the race date of 9 October in the listing.

name: Flisa Backyard
description: Flisa Backyard is a friendly autumn event held at beautiful Myrmoen in Flisa. The race welcomes everyone who wants to challenge themselves, test their fitness or simply enjoy a fantastic day in beautiful surroundings. The event is open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier and offers an inclusive, magical atmosphere. The race is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has a long tradition as a sports club in the area.
course_highlights: The race takes place at beautiful Myrmoen in scenic surroundings
Open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier
One of the autumn’s friendliest events, with an inclusive atmosphere
additional: Everyone born in 2013 or earlier may participate. The event is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has used Rubic as its membership system. Registration is via racetracker.no. Flisa Backyard is an inclusive, social race in the scenic surroundings of Myrmoen. The listed registration price is 450 kr, increasing to 550 kr from 18 January, 650 kr from 1 April and 750 kr from 1 August. Registration includes a choice of single-event or annual licence, and camping can be reserved.

name: Gausta Challenge
location: Gausta Fjellresort, Gausta, Tinn, Telemark, Norway
organizer: Rjukan IL – Friidrett & Triathlon og Gaustablikk Fjellresort
description: Gausta Challenge is a low-key race held on Saturday, October 9, 2027, at Gausta Fjellresort. The race runs around Kvitåvatn on an approximately 6 km gravel road, starting and finishing by the paddle tennis courts. The race is suitable for all ages and levels, with wave starts and timing, and participants can run, walk, or take it easy. The event is a collaboration between Rjukan IL - Friidrett & Triathlon and Gaustablikk Fjellresort, and aims to promote physical activity in beautiful autumn surroundings.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km gravel course around Kvitåvatn
Start and finish at Gausta Fjellresort, by the paddle tennis courts
The course is hilly, with a long downhill section and flat stretches
additional: Wave starts with timing. The children’s race for ages 0–10 starts at 14:00. The 6 km race is open to participants aged 10 to 99. The start and finish are by the paddle tennis courts near the floating saunas. The course is run counterclockwise. Gausta Challenge 2027 takes place on Saturday, October 9, at 13:00. The children’s race starts at 14:00. The 6 km course is for participants aged 10 and over.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand and the final race in the Outnorth Trailtour. The race offers a scenic course with cliffs, jetties, the scent of seaweed and views that soothe the mind while the body works hard. Sweden’s trail-running elite gather here for exciting races in a unique setting where mountains, forest and sea meet. Participants can also extend the experience with accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Scenic views featuring cliffs, jetties and the scent of seaweed
Part of the Outnorth Trailtour, featuring Sweden’s trail-running elite
additional: Accommodation and a banquet are offered at TanumStrand Spa & Resort to round out the weekend. Subscribers get access to a newsletter with current information and offers, including 20% off Asics trail shoes at Outnorth. The organizer’s text recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to guide participants. Runners can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a pleasant atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the race.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Bib numbers must be collected from Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but late registration may be available on site. Medical staff are available at the start and finish. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. Race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class. Bib numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 52nd time, offering both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is flat and straight, with the start and finish at the historic Slottsskogsvallen in Göteborg. It follows an out-and-back route along the old coastal railway embankment, with beautiful views of the sea and archipelago. The race is well organised, with aid stations every four kilometres and a friendly atmosphere welcoming runners of all abilities. It’s a perfect race for anyone looking to run fast and enjoy a scenic course near the sea.
course_highlights: Flat and straight course along the old coastal railway embankment
Turnaround at the Lilla Amundön boat storage area after approximately 10.5 km
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The start and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen. Marathon start group 1 starts at 10:00; half-marathon start group 2 (finish time under 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:30; and half-marathon start group 3 (finish time over 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:45. After finishing, participants are offered a drink and a sandwich. You can have your own fluids or energy products transported to the aid stations. You can sell or transfer your entry place until 2026-10-07 via the marketplace on MittLopp.se for a fee of 100 kr. The bib number must be worn visibly throughout the race. The race offers a marathon and a half marathon. The course was officially measured in 2024.

name: Umemaran
organizer: Jalles TC Umeå och IFK Umeå
description: Umemaran is a running festival that brings runners together in Umeå and is organized by Jalles TC together with IFK Umeå. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a fast, scenic course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides. It has been a tradition since 1973 and also serves as the Northern Norrland Championships for the marathon. Participants are offered refreshments every four kilometres, a medal at the finish, and coffee and a sandwich after the race.
course_highlights: A fast course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Every kilometre is marked, and the course has been officially measured by an SFIF certified course measurer
Refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometres
additional: Slow runners with finish times of 4:45 or longer may start at 10:00 after registering in advance. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jubileumshallen near the start area. Bibs and chips must be collected no later than 45 minutes before the start at Tegs Centralskola, with collection also available the day before at Team Sportia Ersboda. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the 21 km race and at approximately 16:20 for the 42 km race in the auditorium at Tegs Centralskola. Everyone who completes the 42 km race has a chance to win a bicycle in a draw at the prize ceremony. The marathon is the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging cross-country race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet terrain, making it an adventure for anyone who isn’t afraid of getting dirty or tackling challenging terrain. It is a fun and demanding race suited to both seasoned runners and beginners, with an emphasis on fighting spirit and camaraderie. After crossing the finish line, showers and rinse-off facilities are available in tents near the finish. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and trail paths
Challenging natural terrain with wet ground and forest trails
Held in Norra Djurgården, a well-known woodland setting
additional: After the race, hot showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities immediately after crossing the finish line. There are collection bins for clothes that cannot be taken home. Participants are advised to wear clothes they don’t mind getting dirty and shoes with good grip that fit securely to handle the mud.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is a magical running event held during the famous Lights in Alingsås festival. The race offers distances for all ages and levels, from the Knatteloppet for the youngest runners to 10 km for more experienced runners. Enjoy a running celebration amid magical lighting, through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is also part of the Västsvenska löparcupen, offering extra competition opportunities for club runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Routes through beautifully illuminated areas during Lights in Alingsås
Distances from 300 m to 10 km, with varied loops around squares and parks
additional: Start times by distance: Maxi-Knatte 300m at 16:00, Energiloppet 600m at 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 1660m at 16:45, Stafetten 3 x 1660m at 17:05, 5 km at 18:00, 10 km at 19:00. The routes are loops around Stora torget, the river, the squares and Museiparken. The relay is for teams of 3 people, each running one lap. Bib pickup and the running expo are held at Estrad, Bryggerigatan 2. The race is part of the Västsvenska Långloppscupen and Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd terrain at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful nature experience. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd terrain
Passage through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may lead to minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team. Information about the distance and format refers to a previous edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt 2027
description: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt is a traditional forest race that has been held since 1974. The course is 20 km long and is considered one of the true classics among Norwegian forest races, with a runnable route featuring pleasant trail sections and good gravel roads. The start and finish are at FIF-huset in Fredrikstad, and the course includes both flat terrain and some steep climbs, especially in the final section toward Skihytta. A shorter distance called Markatier'n is also held, using the same start and finish area and sharing the 20 km route for the first 5.5 km.
course_highlights: 20 km forest race on a runnable route of trails and gravel roads
Three drink stations along the route at approximately 5.5 km, 10 km, and 14 km
Steep climbs and challenging terrain, especially between 9 and 14 km
additional: There are 3 drink stations with water and cordial along the route, as well as drinks at the finish. The start and finish are at FIF-huset, Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. Markatier'n is a shorter distance that uses the same start and finish area and shares the 20 km route for the first 5.5 km. The course has remained largely unchanged since 1974. Course records are 1:07:08 for men and 1:16:17 for women. The start and finish are at FIF-huset at Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. Registration and results services are stated to be provided in cooperation with EQ Timing.

name: Eremitageløbet
description: The Eremitage Run is a cannonball race in hilly terrain north of Copenhagen. The recreational race always takes place in early October and is the only race in Dyrehaven, north of Copenhagen.

name: Royal Aarhus City Marathon 2027
location: Vester Allé ved ARoS, Aarhus C
description: Royal Aarhus City Marathon is the first city marathon in Aarhus since 2008. The route is one lap of 42.195 km, starting and finishing on Vester Allé by ARoS. You’ll run through the Marselisborg Forests, along the bay and past the Infinite Bridge, across the harbour and out to Aarhus Ø, past Dokk1 and the Cathedral, and around Brabrand Lake before returning to the city centre. The highest point on the route is 60 metres, and around 20 km are car-free paths and pedestrian streets. The time limit is 6 hours. The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a running shirt, aid stations every 5 km with water and sports drink, baggage storage and a digital certificate. Early bird price: DKK 695 through 24 December 2026; afterwards, DKK 795. The organiser is Strata Endurance Events, which also organises Royal Copenhagen City Half and Ørestad Half Marathon.
additional: Start at 09:00 on Sunday 10 October 2027 on Vester Allé by ARoS; finish at the same location. Interactive route map: https://racm-map.vercel.app · Strava route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3550794644934219702. The route is provisional pending final approval from Aarhus Municipality and the police.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Kristiansand
organizer: Kreftforeningen og Brystkreftforeningen, i samarbeid med Springtime Group
price_range: Mini: gratis; kort og lang løype: 500 kr + administrasjonsgebyr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kort løype - 17:00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Pink Ribbon Run in Kristiansand is an annual event held to support the breast cancer cause. The run starts and finishes at Aquarama in the city centre, and the course passes through beautiful areas around Kristiansand. Participants can choose between a short course of approximately 3.4 km or a long course of approximately 5.5 km. There is also a separate children’s race for children aged 3 to 9. All participants receive a race pack with a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event brings together thousands of people in a sea of pink for a good cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aquarama in central Kristiansand
Short course of approx. 3.4 km without timing
Long course of approx. 5.5 km with timing
additional: The race pack includes a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The Mini children’s race is free and approximately 400 metres long, with activities in the start area. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in the start area from 2 hours before the start, or in advance to avoid queues. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association, which also supports the cause. Companies can register using separate registration forms and manage participants through My Page. The race pack contains a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. NOK 250 of the race entry fee goes in full to the Pink Ribbon campaign.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km races start on Saturday, 17 October, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A proper headlamp is recommended, ideally with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a time limit of 4 hours and 30 minutes for the 30 km. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Ivar Formos Minneløp 2027
description: Ivar Formos Minneløp is a traditional cross-country race in Oslo, offering scenic and challenging courses in Nordmarka. The race has distances for both children and adults, including a tough 17 km course that follows the terrain where Ivar Formo trained to become an Olympic champion. The start and finish are at Sognsvann Snøpark, and the courses feature beautiful trails, panoramic views of the city, and several aid stations along the way. The event is a sweaty pleasure for everyone who enjoys running in the forest, with a new 10 km course that is undulating and challenging without steep climbs or descents.
course_highlights: 17 km course starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snøpark, with panoramic views of Oslo from Vettakollen and Frønsvollen
The course passes well-known places such as Båntjern, Skjennungstua, Ullevålseter, and Lynhytta, with aid stations
New 10 km course on beautiful forest trails, with challenging, undulating terrain and no steep hills
additional: Start and finish at Sognsvann Snøpark. Timing chip included in the race bib, except for the children's race, which is untimed. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. Registration is binding, with no refunds in case of illness or injury. Race bibs can be resold via EQ Timing. No T-shirts will be sold in 2027 due to low interest. In 2027, the race will be held for the 15th time. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. The timing chip is included in the race bib, and the children's race is untimed. Registration is binding, and a one-off licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Volda Bakgårdsultra 2027
description: Volda Bakgårdsultra is a social and inclusive ultramarathon based on the backyard ultra concept, where participants run 12 laps of 6.7 km, with a new start every hour on the hour. The race starts in the SpareBank 1 Hall at Volda Stadium and is suitable for all levels, from those who want to complete one lap to those aiming to finish the classic ultra distance of 50 miles (80.4 km). The event has been a success since 2025 and offers a unique running experience focused on community and personal challenge. Between laps, participants can rest in the hall, with access to a drop bag area and kiosk. Registration for 2027 opens on 16 January at 20:00 via EQ Timing.
course_highlights: 12 laps of 6.7 km, with a start every hour on the hour
The course is mostly gravel road with little elevation gain
Start and finish in the SpareBank 1 Hall, with access to a rest area and drop bag area
additional: The race has a basic aid station with water, sports drinks, fruit and salty snacks. Participants can also bring their own food and drinks and set up personal drop bags by the start/finish area. Free parking is available at Volda Stadium, and Volda town centre is within walking distance of the venue. Volda Airport Hovden is a 10-minute drive away. The hall has a kiosk selling coffee, soft drinks, chocolate and other light refreshments. Participants must have a valid licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation or purchase a one-day licence when registering. The provisional date is 16 October 2027, with a start at 08:00. Registration has not opened yet; the final date and registration information are to be confirmed in January 2027.

name: Furumomila 2027
description: Furumomila is a traditional cross-country race held for the 44th time at Furumo Idrettspark. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km cross-country race, MiniMil, a recreational walk and SpareBank1 Modum’s cross-country race. Participants can look forward to generous cash prizes, gift cards, medals and pins. This autumn adventure welcomes both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over varied terrain
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km, MiniMil and a recreational walk
Start and finish at Furumo Idrettspark
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the tent by the clubhouse before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking and a shuttle bus are provided. Prizes are awarded shortly after the finish for the various distances. A one-time licence is required for those without an annual licence, in accordance with the rules of the Norwegian Athletics Federation. Previous editions have distributed race numbers by the clubhouse. Distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Hytteplanmila
description: Hytteplanmila is an annual fun run held at Svensrudmoen in October. The race features a fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course, known as one of Norway’s fastest 10K road race routes. Participants can experience a varied course with both easy and challenging sections, including a demanding finish on Pulsbakken. The event attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes, with separate start groups for the elite field.
course_highlights: Fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course
The race’s challenging finish on Pulsbakken
Great views over Steinssletta and historic sites such as Mo gård
additional: Registration opens in November. Entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be transferred. Those who register by the deadlines receive a buff and running socks, distributed on race day. It is possible to pre-order a race pack with energy products. Elite athletes can register by email for separate start groups. Buses to the race are arranged from Oslo and Gardermoen. The time limit is 1 hour and 40 minutes. Registration for 2027 opens in November; information about the entry fee has not yet been published.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course run over eight laps around the beautiful Växjösjön. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation change—about 3 metres per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers relay races for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation change per lap
Mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, with a lead cyclist and course marshals. It is not closed to traffic during the race. Relay races are also available for teams, and a children’s race is held. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Löparklubb. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic. Sources do not confirm the details for the 2027 edition.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Brantaste Mini kostar 200 kronor hela vägen fram till start.

description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense, high-energy race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactate threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Uphill on two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views over Stockholm
additional: Race bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. The race bib is personal and must be worn on the chest with safety pins. There are water stations along the course. In the relay, teams complete 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easily accessible by public transport; parking is limited. The 2026 edition is listed as taking place on October 17; information about the 2027 race has not yet been confirmed in the available sources. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valles Kompislopp is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the slope.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Gjesdal Trailrun
location: Gjesdal IL athletics facility, Solås, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway
